sentences.zh: 賀拔允 蔡儁 韓賢 尉長命 王懷 劉貴 任延敬 莫多婁貸文 高市貴 厙狄迴洛 厙狄盛 薛孤延 張保洛 侯莫陳相

translations.literal: He Bayun; Cai Jun; Han Xian; Wei Zhangming; Wang Huai; Liu Gui; Ren Yanjing; Moduoluo Daiwen; Gao Shigui; Shidi Huiluo; Shidi Sheng; Xue Guyan; Zhang Baoluo; Houmo Chenxiang
translations.idiomatic: He Bayun; Cai Jun; Han Xian; Wei Zhangming; Wang Huai; Liu Gui; Ren Yanjing; Moduoluo Daiwen; Gao Shigui; Shidi Huiluo; Shidi Sheng; Xue Guyan; Zhang Baoluo; Houmo Chenxiang

sentences.zh: 賀拔允，字可泥，神武尖山人也。

translations.literal: He Bayun, styled Kenui, was a native of Jianshan in Shenwu.
translations.idiomatic: He Bayun, styled Kenui, was a native of Jianshan in Shenwu.

sentences.zh: 祖爾頭，父度拔，俱見魏史。

translations.literal: His grandfather Ertou and his father Dubá are both recorded in the Wei History.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Ertou and his father Dubá are both recorded in the Wei History.

sentences.zh: 允便弓馬，頗有膽略，與弟嶽殺賊帥衛可肱，仍奔魏。

translations.literal: Bayun was skilled with bow and horse and possessed considerable daring and resource; with his younger brother Yue he killed the bandit chief Wei Kehong, then fled to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: He Bayun excelled with bow and horse and possessed considerable daring; with his younger brother Yue he killed the bandit chief Wei Kehong, then fled to Wei.

sentences.zh: 廣陽王元深上允為積射將軍，持節防滏口。

translations.literal: Prince Yuanshen of Guangyang recommended Bayun as General of Accumulated Archers, with staff of authority defending Fukou.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yuanshen of Guangyang recommended He Bayun as general of accumulated archers, bearer of the staff of authority defending Fukou.

sentences.zh: 深敗，歸尒朱榮。

translations.literal: When Yuanshen was defeated, he returned to Erzhu Rong.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanshen was defeated, he returned to Erzhu Rong.

sentences.zh: 允父子兄弟並以武藝知名，榮素聞之。

translations.literal: Bayun, his father, his sons, and his brothers were all known for martial skill; Rong had long heard of them.
translations.idiomatic: He Bayun, his father, his sons, and his brothers were all known for martial skill; Erzhu Rong had long heard of them.

sentences.zh: 見允，待之甚厚。

translations.literal: When he met Bayun, he treated him with great generosity.
translations.idiomatic: When he met He Bayun, he treated him with great generosity.

sentences.zh: 建義初，除征東將軍、光祿大夫，封壽陽縣侯，邑七百戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyi, Bayun was appointed General Who Subdues the East and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, enfeoffed Marquis of Shouyang County with a fief of seven hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianyi, He Bayun was appointed general who subdues the east and grand master of splendid happiness, enfeoffed marquis of Shouyang County with a fief of seven hundred households.

sentences.zh: 永安中，除征北將軍、蔚州刺史，進爵為公。

translations.literal: During Yongan, he was appointed General Who Subdues the North and Governor of Weizhou, and his rank was advanced to Duke.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongan, he was appointed general who subdues the north and governor of Weizhou, and his rank was advanced to duke.

sentences.zh: 魏長廣王立，改封燕郡公，兼侍中。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Changguang of Wei was enthroned, Bayun's title was changed to Duke of Yan Commandery, and he was made concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Changguang of Wei was enthroned, He Bayun's title was changed to duke of Yan Commandery, and he was made concurrent palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 使茹茹，還至晉陽，值高祖將出山東，允素知高祖非常人，早自結托。

translations.literal: Sent on mission to the Rouran, on his return he reached Jinyang just as the Grand Ancestor was about to march east out of Shandong; Bayun had long known the Grand Ancestor was no ordinary man and had early pledged himself to him.
translations.idiomatic: Sent on mission to the Rouran, on his return he reached Jinyang just as Gao Huan was about to march east out of Shandong; He Bayun had long known Gao Huan was no ordinary man and had early pledged himself to him.

sentences.zh: 高祖以其北士之望，尤親禮之。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor, because Bayun was a man of standing among the northern gentry, treated him with especial affection and honor.
translations.idiomatic: Because He Bayun was a man of standing among the northern gentry, Gao Huan treated him with especial affection and honor.

sentences.zh: 遂與允出信都，參定大策。

translations.literal: He then went out from Xindu with Bayun to settle the great plan.
translations.idiomatic: He then went out from Xindu with He Bayun to settle the great plan.

sentences.zh: 魏中興初，轉司徒，領尚書令。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wei Zhongxing, Bayun was transferred to Minister over the Masses and held concurrently the office of Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wei Zhongxing, He Bayun was transferred to minister over the masses and held concurrently the office of director of the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 高祖入洛，進爵為王，轉太尉，加侍中。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor entered Luoyang, Bayun's rank was advanced to Prince, he was transferred to Grand Commandant, and made additionally Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan entered Luoyang, He Bayun's rank was advanced to prince, he was transferred to grand commandant, and made additionally palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 魏武帝之猜忌高祖也，以允弟岳深相委托，潛使來往。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu of Wei was suspicious of the Grand Ancestor, because Bayun's younger brother Yue was deeply entrusted to him, they secretly sent messengers back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Wei was suspicious of Gao Huan, because He Bayun's younger brother Yue was deeply entrusted to him, they secretly sent messengers back and forth.

sentences.zh: 當時咸慮允為變。

translations.literal: At the time all feared Bayun would turn traitor.
translations.idiomatic: At the time all feared He Bayun would turn traitor.

sentences.zh: 及岳死，武帝又委岳弟勝心腹之寄。

translations.literal: When Yue died, Emperor Wu again entrusted Yue's younger brother Sheng with the most intimate confidence.
translations.idiomatic: When Yue died, Emperor Wu again entrusted Yue's younger brother Sheng with the most intimate confidence.

sentences.zh: 高祖重其舊，久全護之。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor, valuing their old ties, long protected him intact.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan, valuing their old ties, long protected him intact.

sentences.zh: 天平元年乃賜死，時年四十八，高祖親臨哭。

translations.literal: Only in the first year of Tianping was Bayun granted death by imperial decree; he was forty-eight, and the Grand Ancestor came in person to mourn.
translations.idiomatic: Only in the first year of Tianping was He Bayun granted death by imperial decree; he was forty-eight, and Gao Huan came in person to mourn.

sentences.zh: 贈定州刺史、五州軍事。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was granted Governor of Ding Province and command over military affairs in five provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted governor of Ding Province and command over military affairs in five provinces.

sentences.zh: 允有三子，長子世文，次世樂，次難陀。

translations.literal: Bayun had three sons: the eldest Shiwen, the second Shile, and the third Nantuo.
translations.idiomatic: He Bayun had three sons: the eldest Shiwen, the second Shile, and the third Nantuo.

sentences.zh: 興和末，高祖並召與諸子同學。

translations.literal: At the end of Xinghe, the Grand Ancestor summoned them all to study together with his own sons.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Xinghe, Gao Huan summoned them all to study together with his own sons.

sentences.zh: 武定中，勑居定州，賜其田宅。

translations.literal: During Wuding, an edict ordered them to reside in Ding Province and granted them fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: During Wuding, an edict ordered them to reside in Ding Province and granted them fields and dwellings.

sentences.zh: 蔡儁，字景彥，廣寧石門人也。

translations.literal: Cai Jun, styled Jingyan, was a native of Shimen in Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Jun, styled Jingyan, was a native of Shimen in Guangning.

sentences.zh: 父普，北方擾亂，奔走五原，守戰有功。

translations.literal: His father Pu, when the north was in turmoil, fled to Wuyuan; in garrison and battle he had merit.
translations.idiomatic: His father Pu, when the north was in turmoil, fled to Wuyuan; in garrison and battle he had merit.

sentences.zh: 拜寧朔將軍，封安上縣男，邑二百戶。

translations.literal: He was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and enfeoffed Baron of Anshang County with a fief of two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed general who pacifies the north and enfeoffed baron of Anshang County with a fief of two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，贈輔國將軍、燕州剌史。

translations.literal: Soon after he died and was posthumously granted General Who Assists the State and Governor of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he died and was posthumously granted general who assists the state and governor of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 儁豪爽有膽氣，高祖微時，深相親附。

translations.literal: Jun was bold and generous with courage; when the Grand Ancestor was still obscure, Jun attached himself deeply to him.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Jun was bold and generous with courage; when Gao Huan was still obscure, he attached himself deeply to him.

sentences.zh: 與遼西段長、太原龐蒼鷹俱有先知之鑒。

translations.literal: Together with Duan Chang of Liaoxi and Pang Cangying of Taiyuan, he possessed the discerning eye of one who sees ahead.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Duan Chang of Liaoxi and Pang Cangying of Taiyuan, he possessed the discerning eye of one who sees ahead.

sentences.zh: 長為魏懷朔鎮將，嘗見高祖，甚異之，謂高祖云：「君有康世之才，終不徒然也，請以子孫為託。

translations.literal: Chang was commandant of Huashuo garrison in Wei; once when he saw the Grand Ancestor he found him very remarkable and said to him: "You have the talent to bring order to the age; in the end you will not come to nothing — please accept my descendants as a trust.
translations.idiomatic: Chang was commandant of Huashuo garrison in Wei; once when he saw Gao Huan he found him very remarkable and said to him: "You have the talent to bring order to the age; in the end you will not come to nothing — please accept my descendants as a trust.

sentences.zh: 」興和中，啟贈司空公。

translations.literal: " In Xinghe, the Grand Ancestor memorialized to posthumously grant Chang Duke of Works.
translations.idiomatic: " In Xinghe, Gao Huan memorialized to posthumously grant Chang duke of works.

sentences.zh: 子寧，相府從事中郎，天保初，兼南中郎將。

translations.literal: His son Ning was aide in the chief minister's headquarters; at the beginning of Tianbao he was made concurrently General of the Southern Central Cadres.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ning was aide in the chief minister's headquarters; at the beginning of Tianbao he was made concurrently general of the southern central cadres.

sentences.zh: 蒼鷹交遊豪俠，厚待賓旅，居於州城。

translations.literal: Cangying consorted with bold knights-errant and treated traveling guests generously; he lived in the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Cangying consorted with bold knights-errant and treated traveling guests generously; he lived in the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 高祖客其舍，初居處於蝸牛廬中，蒼鷹母數見廬上赤氣屬天。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor lodged at his house; at first he dwelt in a snail-shell hut, and Cangying's mother several times saw red vapor on the hut reaching to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan lodged at his house; at first he dwelt in a snail-shell hut, and Cangying's mother several times saw red vapor on the hut reaching to heaven.

sentences.zh: 蒼鷹亦知高祖有霸王之量，每私加敬，割其宅半以奉高祖，由此遂蒙親識。

translations.literal: Cangying too knew the Grand Ancestor had the measure of a hegemon-king; he always privately showed him extra respect, ceded half his house to serve the Grand Ancestor, and thereby came to receive personal recognition.
translations.idiomatic: Cangying too knew Gao Huan had the measure of a hegemon-king; he always privately showed him extra respect, ceded half his house to serve Gao Huan, and thereby came to receive personal recognition.

sentences.zh: 高祖之牧晉州，引為兼治中從事史，行義寧郡事。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor governed Jin Province, he brought Cangying in as concurrent aide-de-camp administrative secretary and charged him with the affairs of Yining Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan governed Jin Province, he brought Cangying in as concurrent aide-de-camp administrative secretary and charged him with the affairs of Yining Commandery.

sentences.zh: 及義旗建，蒼鷹乃棄家間行歸高祖，高祖以為兼行臺倉部郎中。

translations.literal: When the banner of righteousness was raised, Cangying abandoned his household and traveled secretly by side paths to rejoin the Grand Ancestor; the Grand Ancestor made him concurrent director of the granary section in the mobile office.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner of righteousness was raised, Cangying abandoned his household and traveled secretly by side paths to rejoin Gao Huan; Gao Huan made him concurrent director of the granary section in the mobile office.

sentences.zh: 卒於安州刺史。

translations.literal: He died while serving as Governor of An Province.
translations.idiomatic: He died while serving as governor of An Province.

sentences.zh: 儁初為杜洛周所虜，時高祖亦在洛周軍中，高祖謀誅洛周，儁預其計。

translations.literal: Jun was at first captured by Du Luozhou; at the time the Grand Ancestor was also in Luozhou's army; the Grand Ancestor plotted to kill Luozhou, and Jun took part in the plan.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Jun was at first captured by Du Luozhou; at the time Gao Huan was also in Luozhou's army; Gao Huan plotted to kill Luozhou, and Cai Jun took part in the plan.

sentences.zh: 事泄，走奔葛榮，仍背葛歸尒朱榮。

translations.literal: When the affair was exposed, he fled to Ge Rong, then turned against Ge and went over to Erzhu Rong.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was exposed, he fled to Ge Rong, then turned against Ge and went over to Erzhu Rong.

sentences.zh: 榮入洛，為平遠將軍、帳內別將。

translations.literal: When Rong entered Luoyang, Jun was made General Who Pacifies the Distance and a separate commander within the headquarters guard.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong entered Luoyang, Cai Jun was made general who pacifies the distance and a separate commander within the headquarters guard.

sentences.zh: 從破葛榮，除諫議大夫。

translations.literal: He followed in the defeat of Ge Rong and was appointed Grand Advisor for Remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: He followed in the defeat of Ge Rong and was appointed grand advisor for remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 又從平元顥，封烏洛縣男。

translations.literal: He also followed in the pacification of Yuan Hao and was enfeoffed Baron of Wuluo County.
translations.idiomatic: He also followed in the pacification of Yuan Hao and was enfeoffed baron of Wuluo County.

sentences.zh: 隨高祖舉義，為都督。

translations.literal: He followed the Grand Ancestor in raising righteousness and was made Area Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Gao Huan in raising righteousness and was made area commander.

sentences.zh: 高祖平鄴，及破四胡於韓陵，儁並有戰功。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor pacified Ye and when he defeated the Four Huns at Hanling, Jun had military merit in both.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan pacified Ye and when he defeated the Four Huns at Hanling, Cai Jun had military merit in both.

sentences.zh: 太昌中，出為濟州剌史，為治嚴暴，又多受納，然亦明解有部分，吏民畏服之。

translations.literal: During Taichang he went out as Governor of Ji Province; his governance was harsh and violent and he accepted many bribes, yet he was also clear-minded and had method, and officials and commoners feared and obeyed him.
translations.idiomatic: During Taichang he went out as governor of Ji Province; his governance was harsh and violent and he accepted many bribes, yet he was also clear-minded and had method, and officials and commoners feared and obeyed him.

sentences.zh: 性好賓客，頗稱施與。

translations.literal: By nature he loved entertaining guests and was noted for generous giving.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he loved entertaining guests and was noted for generous giving.

sentences.zh: 後胡遷等據兗州作逆，儁與齊州刺史尉景討平之。

translations.literal: Later Hu Qian and others seized Yan Province in rebellion; Jun together with Wei Jing, Governor of Qi Province, suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Later Hu Qian and others seized Yan Province in rebellion; Cai Jun together with Wei Jing, governor of Qi Province, suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 魏武帝貳於高祖，以濟州要重，欲令腹心據之。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Wei was disloyal to the Grand Ancestor; because Ji Province was strategically vital, he wished to place a trusted confidant in command there.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Wei was disloyal to Gao Huan; because Ji Province was strategically vital, he wished to place a trusted confidant in command there.

sentences.zh: 陰詔禦史構儁罪狀，欲以汝陽王代儁，由是轉行兗州事。

translations.literal: He secretly ordered censors to fabricate charges against Jun, intending to replace Jun with the Prince of Ruyang, and for this reason Jun was transferred to administer Yan Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly ordered censors to fabricate charges against Cai Jun, intending to replace him with the Prince of Ruyang, and for this reason Cai Jun was transferred to administer Yan Province affairs.

sentences.zh: 高祖以儁非罪，啟復其任。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor, holding that Jun was not guilty, memorialized to restore him to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan, holding that Cai Jun was not guilty, memorialized to restore him to his post.

sentences.zh: 武帝不許，除賈顯智為刺史，率衆赴州。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu did not consent; he appointed Jia Xianzhi governor and sent him at the head of troops to take the province.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu did not consent; he appointed Jia Xianzhi governor and sent him at the head of troops to take the province.

sentences.zh: 儁以防守嚴備，顯智憚之，至東郡，不敢前。

translations.literal: Jun's defenses were strict and thorough; Xianzhi feared him, and when he reached Dong Commandery he dared not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Jun's defenses were strict and thorough; Xianzhi feared him, and when he reached Dong Commandery he dared not advance.

sentences.zh: 天平中，為都督，隨領軍婁昭攻樊子鵠於兗州，又與行臺元子思討元慶和，俱平之。

translations.literal: During Tianping he served as Area Commander; he followed the army superintendent Lou Zhao in attacking Fan Zihu at Yan Province, and again with the mobile office commander Yuan Zisi suppressed Yuan Qinghe — both were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianping he served as area commander; he followed the army superintendent Lou Zhao in attacking Fan Zihu at Yan Province, and again with the mobile office commander Yuan Zisi suppressed Yuan Qinghe — both were pacified.

sentences.zh: 侯深反，復以儁為大都督，率衆討之，深敗走。

translations.literal: When Hou Shen rebelled, Jun was again made Grand Area Commander, led troops to suppress him, and Shen was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Shen rebelled, Cai Jun was again made grand area commander, led troops to suppress him, and Shen was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 又轉揚州刺史。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 天平三年秋，卒於州，時年四十二。

translations.literal: In autumn of the third year of Tianping he died in office, aged forty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the third year of Tianping he died in office, aged forty-two.

sentences.zh: 贈持節、侍中、都督、冀州刺史、尚書令、司空公，諡曰威武。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was granted Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Palace Attendant, Area Commander, Governor of Ji Province, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Duke of Works; his posthumous title was Majestic and Martial.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted bearer of the staff of authority, palace attendant, area commander, governor of Ji Province, director of the masters of writing, and duke of works; his posthumous title was Majestic and Martial.

sentences.zh: 齊受禪，詔祭告其墓。

translations.literal: When Qi received the abdication, an edict ordered sacrifice announced at his tomb.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi received the abdication, an edict ordered sacrifice announced at his tomb.

sentences.zh: 皇建初，配享高祖廟庭。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian he was given associated sacrifice in the Grand Ancestor's temple court.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Huangjian he was given associated sacrifice in Gao Huan's temple court.

sentences.zh: 韓賢，字普賢，廣寧石門人也。

translations.literal: Han Xian, styled Puxian, was a native of Shimen in Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: Han Xian, styled Puxian, was a native of Shimen in Guangning.

sentences.zh: 壯健有武用。

translations.literal: He was robust and had martial ability.
translations.idiomatic: He was robust and had martial ability.

sentences.zh: 初隨葛榮作逆，榮破，隨例至幷州，尒朱榮擢充左右。

translations.literal: At first he followed Ge Rong in rebellion; when Ge was broken he went with the rest to Bing Province, and Erzhu Rong selected him to fill out his personal guard.
translations.idiomatic: At first he followed Ge Rong in rebellion; when Ge was broken he went with the rest to Bing Province, and Erzhu Rong selected him to fill out his personal guard.

sentences.zh: 榮妻子北走，世隆等立魏長廣王曄為主，除賢鎮遠將軍、屯騎校尉。

translations.literal: When Rong's wife and children fled north, Shilong and others enthroned Yuan Ye, Prince of Changguang of Wei, as sovereign; Xian was appointed General Who Pacifies the Distance and Colonel of Garrison Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong's wife and children fled north, Shilong and others enthroned Yuan Ye, Prince of Changguang of Wei, as sovereign; Han Xian was appointed general who pacifies the distance and colonel of garrison cavalry.

sentences.zh: 先是，世隆等攻建州及石城，賢並有戰功。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Shilong and others attacked Jian Province and Shicheng, Xian had military merit in both.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Shilong and others attacked Jian Province and Shicheng, Han Xian had military merit in both.

sentences.zh: 尒朱度律用為帳內都督，封汾陽縣伯，邑四百戶。

translations.literal: Erzhu Dulü employed him as a headquarters area commander and enfeoffed him as Count of Fenyang County with a fief of four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Dulü employed him as a headquarters area commander and enfeoffed him as count of Fenyang County with a fief of four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，除前將軍、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai he was appointed General of the Forward Army and Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai he was appointed general of the forward army and governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 屬高祖起義，度律以賢素為高祖所知，恐其有變，遣使征之。

translations.literal: Just then the Grand Ancestor raised righteousness; Dulü, because Xian was known to be acquainted with the Grand Ancestor, feared he might turn, and sent messengers to summon him.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Gao Huan raised righteousness; Dulü, because Han Xian was known to be acquainted with Gao Huan, feared he might turn, and sent messengers to summon him.

sentences.zh: 賢不願應召，乃密遣群蠻，多舉烽火，有如寇難將至。

translations.literal: Xian did not wish to answer the summons; he secretly sent out tribal allies to raise many beacon fires, as though invaders were about to arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Han Xian did not wish to answer the summons; he secretly sent out tribal allies to raise many beacon fires, as though invaders were about to arrive.

sentences.zh: 使者遂為啟，得停。

translations.literal: The messengers then reported on it and were allowed to halt.
translations.idiomatic: The messengers then reported on it and were allowed to halt.

sentences.zh: 賢仍潛遣使人通誠於高祖。

translations.literal: Xian still secretly sent envoys to declare his loyalty to the Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Han Xian still secretly sent envoys to declare his loyalty to Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 高祖入洛，尒朱官爵例皆削除，以賢遠送誠款，令其復舊。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor entered Luoyang, Erzhu offices and ranks were as a rule all struck off; because Xian had long sent pledges of loyalty, he was ordered restored to his former status.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan entered Luoyang, Erzhu offices and ranks were as a rule all struck off; because Han Xian had long sent pledges of loyalty, he was ordered restored to his former status.

sentences.zh: 太昌初，累遷中軍將軍、光祿大夫，出為建州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taichang he rose through appointments to General of the Central Army and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and went out as Governor of Jian Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taichang he rose through appointments to general of the central army and grand master of splendid happiness, and went out as governor of Jian Province.

sentences.zh: 武帝西入，轉行荊州事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu entered the west, Xian was transferred to administer Jing Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu entered the west, Han Xian was transferred to administer Jing Province affairs.

sentences.zh: 天平初，為洛州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianping he became Governor of Luo Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianping he became governor of Luo Province.

sentences.zh: 民韓木蘭等率土民作逆，賢擊破之，親自按檢，欲收甲仗。

translations.literal: The commoner Han Mulan and others led local people in rebellion; Xian defeated them and personally went about inspecting, intending to collect weapons and armor.
translations.idiomatic: The commoner Han Mulan and others led local people in rebellion; Han Xian defeated them and personally went about inspecting, intending to collect weapons and armor.

sentences.zh: 有一賊窘迫，藏於死屍之間，見賢將至，忽起斫之，斷其脛而卒。

translations.literal: One bandit, cornered, hid among the corpses; when he saw Xian approaching he suddenly rose and hacked at him, severing his shanks, and Xian died.
translations.idiomatic: One bandit, cornered, hid among the corpses; when he saw Han Xian approaching he suddenly rose and hacked at him, severing his shanks, and Han Xian died.

sentences.zh: 賢雖武將，性和直，不甚貪暴，所歷雖無善政，不為吏民所苦。

translations.literal: Though Xian was a military man, his nature was upright and direct, and he was not greatly greedy or violent; in the places he held office, though there was no notable good governance, officials and commoners were not made to suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Though Han Xian was a military man, his nature was upright and direct, and he was not greatly greedy or violent; in the places he held office, though there was no notable good governance, officials and commoners were not made to suffer.

sentences.zh: 昔漢明帝時，西域以白馬負佛經送洛，因立白馬寺，其經函傳在此寺，形制淳朴，世以為古物，歷代藏寶。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Ming of Han, the Western Regions sent Buddhist sutras to Luoyang borne on a white horse, and thereby White Horse Temple was founded; the sutra casket passed down at this temple was simple and unadorned in form, and the world regarded it as an ancient relic treasured through the generations.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of Emperor Ming of Han, the Western Regions sent Buddhist sutras to Luoyang borne on a white horse, and thereby White Horse Temple was founded; the sutra casket passed down at this temple was simple and unadorned in form, and the world regarded it as an ancient relic treasured through the generations.

sentences.zh: 賢無故斫破之，未幾而死，論者或謂賢因此致禍。

translations.literal: Xian for no reason hacked it apart; before long he died, and commentators some said Xian brought calamity upon himself thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Han Xian for no reason hacked it apart; before long he died, and some commentators said he brought calamity upon himself thereby.

sentences.zh: 贈侍中、持節、定營安平四州軍事、大將軍、尚書令、司空公、定州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was granted Palace Attendant, Bearer of the Staff of Authority, command over military affairs in the four provinces of Ding, Ying, Anping, and the rest, Grand General, Director of the Masters of Writing, Duke of Works, and Governor of Ding Province.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted palace attendant, bearer of the staff of authority, command over military affairs in the four provinces of Ding, Ying, Anping, and the rest, grand general, director of the masters of writing, duke of works, and governor of Ding Province.

sentences.zh: 子裔嗣。

translations.literal: His son Yi succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yi succeeded.

sentences.zh: 尉長命，太安狄那人也。

translations.literal: Wei Zhangming was a native of Dina in Tai'an.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhangming was a native of Dina in Tai'an.

sentences.zh: 父顯，魏鎮遠將軍、代郡太守。

translations.literal: His father Xian was General Who Pacifies the Distance in Wei and Administrator of Dai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xian was general who pacifies the distance in Wei and administrator of Dai Commandery.

sentences.zh: 長命性和厚，有器識。

translations.literal: Zhangming by nature was gentle and generous, with capacity and discernment.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhangming by nature was gentle and generous, with capacity and discernment.

sentences.zh: 扶陽之亂，寄居太原。

translations.literal: During the turmoil of Fuyang he took refuge in Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: During the turmoil of Fuyang he took refuge in Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 及高祖將建大義，長命參計策，從高祖破四胡於韓陵，拜安南將軍。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor was about to establish the great cause, Zhangming took part in planning; he followed the Grand Ancestor in defeating the Four Huns at Hanling and was appointed General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan was about to establish the great cause, Wei Zhangming took part in planning; he followed Gao Huan in defeating the Four Huns at Hanling and was appointed general who pacifies the south.

sentences.zh: 樊子鵠據兗州反，除東南道大都督，與諸軍討平之。

translations.literal: When Fan Zihu seized Yan Province in rebellion, Zhangming was appointed Grand Area Commander of the Southeast Circuit and with the various armies suppressed and pacified the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: When Fan Zihu seized Yan Province in rebellion, Wei Zhangming was appointed grand area commander of the southeast circuit and with the various armies suppressed and pacified the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 轉鎮范陽城，就拜幽州剌史，督安、平二州事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to garrison Fanyang city, and at the same post was appointed Governor of You Province, supervising affairs in An and Ping provinces.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to garrison Fanyang city, and at the same post was appointed governor of You Province, supervising affairs in An and Ping provinces.

sentences.zh: 州居北垂，土荒民散，長命雖多聚斂，然以恩撫民，少得安集。

translations.literal: The province lay on the northern frontier; land was wasted and people scattered; though Zhangming collected much in taxes, he yet treated the people with kindness, and a modest degree of settlement and order was achieved.
translations.idiomatic: The province lay on the northern frontier; land was wasted and people scattered; though Wei Zhangming collected much in taxes, he yet treated the people with kindness, and a modest degree of settlement and order was achieved.

sentences.zh: 尋以疾去職。

translations.literal: Before long he left office on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he left office on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復征拜車騎大將軍、都督西燕、幽、滄、瀛四州諸軍事、幽州刺史。

translations.literal: Not long after, he was again summoned and appointed Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Area Commander over military affairs in the four provinces of Xiyan, You, Cang, and Ying, and Governor of You Province.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, he was again summoned and appointed grand general of chariots and cavalry, area commander over military affairs in the four provinces of Xiyan, You, Cang, and Ying, and governor of You Province.

sentences.zh: 卒於州。

translations.literal: He died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office.

sentences.zh: 贈以本官，加司空，諡曰武壯。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted his former offices with the addition of Minister of Works; his posthumous title was Martial and Strong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted his former offices with the addition of minister of works; his posthumous title was Martial and Strong.

sentences.zh: 子興敬，便弓馬，有武藝，高祖引為帳內都督。

translations.literal: His son Xingjing was skilled with bow and horse, had martial arts, and the Grand Ancestor brought him in as a headquarters area commander.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xingjing was skilled with bow and horse, had martial arts, and Gao Huan brought him in as a headquarters area commander.

sentences.zh: 出為常山公府參軍事，賜爵集中縣伯。

translations.literal: He went out as staff officer in the household of the Duke of Changshan and was granted the rank of Count of Jizhong County.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as staff officer in the household of the Duke of Changshan and was granted the rank of count of Jizhong County.

sentences.zh: 晉州民李小興群聚為賊，興敬隨司空韓軌討平之，進爵為侯。

translations.literal: The commoners of Jin Province, Li Xiaoxing and others, gathered in bands as bandits; Xingjing followed the Duke of Works Han Gui in suppressing and pacifying them, and his rank was advanced to Marquis.
translations.idiomatic: The commoners of Jin Province, Li Xiaoxing and others, gathered in bands as bandits; Xingjing followed the Duke of Works Han Gui in suppressing and pacifying them, and his rank was advanced to marquis.

sentences.zh: 高祖攻周文帝於邙山，興敬因戰為流矢所中，卒。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor attacked the Emperor Wen of Zhou at Mount Mang, Xingjing was struck by a stray arrow in battle and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan attacked the Emperor Wen of Zhou at Mount Mang, Xingjing was struck by a stray arrow in battle and died.

sentences.zh: 贈涇岐豳三州軍事，爵為公，諡曰閔莊。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was granted command over military affairs in the three provinces of Jing, Qi, and Bin; his rank was advanced to Duke; his posthumous title was Minzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted command over military affairs in the three provinces of Jing, Qi, and Bin; his rank was advanced to duke; his posthumous title was Minzhuang.

sentences.zh: 高祖哀惜之，親臨吊，賜其妻子祿如興敬存焉。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor grieved for him, came in person to mourn, and granted his wife and children stipends as though Xingjing were still alive.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan grieved for him, came in person to mourn, and granted his wife and children stipends as though Xingjing were still alive.

sentences.zh: 子士林嗣。

translations.literal: His son Shilin succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shilin succeeded.

sentences.zh: 王懷，字懷周，不知何許人也。

translations.literal: Wang Huai, styled Huaizhou, was a man whose origins are unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huai, styled Huaizhou, was a man whose origins are unknown.

sentences.zh: 少好弓馬，頗有氣尚，值北邊喪亂，早從戎旅。

translations.literal: From youth he loved bow and horse and possessed considerable martial spirit; when the northern frontier fell into turmoil, he entered military service early.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he loved bow and horse and possessed considerable martial spirit; when the northern frontier fell into turmoil, he entered military service early.

sentences.zh: 韓樓反於幽州，懷知其無成，陰結所親，以中興初叛樓歸魏，拜征虜將軍、第一領民酋長、武周縣侯。

translations.literal: When Han Lou rebelled in You Province, Huai knew he would not succeed; he secretly rallied his intimates, and at the beginning of Zhongxing rebelled against Lou and returned to Wei, receiving appointment as General Who Subdues Captives, first chief of a dependent people, and Marquis of Wuzhou County.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Lou rebelled in You Province, Wang Huai knew he would not succeed; he secretly rallied his intimates, and at the beginning of Zhongxing rebelled against Lou and returned to Wei, receiving appointment as general who subdues captives, first chief of a dependent people, and marquis of Wuzhou County.

sentences.zh: 高祖東出，懷率其部人三千餘家，隨高祖於冀州。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor marched east, Huai led more than three thousand households of his followers and joined him in Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan marched east, Wang Huai led more than three thousand households of his followers and joined him in Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 義旗建，高祖以為大都督，從討尒朱兆於廣阿，破之，除安北將軍、蔚州刺史。

translations.literal: When the banner of righteousness was raised, the Grand Ancestor made him Grand Commander; he followed in the campaign against Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a, defeated him, and was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner of righteousness was raised, Gao Huan made him grand commander; he followed in the campaign against Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a, defeated him, and was appointed general who pacifies the north and governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 又隨高祖攻鄴，克之，從破四胡於韓陵，進爵為侯。

translations.literal: He again followed the Grand Ancestor in assaulting Ye, captured it, and followed in defeating the Four Huns at Hanling; his rank was advanced to Marquis.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Gao Huan in assaulting Ye, captured it, and followed in defeating the Four Huns at Hanling; his rank was advanced to marquis.

sentences.zh: 仍從入洛，拜車騎將軍，改封盧鄉縣侯。

translations.literal: He still followed him into Luoyang, was appointed Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, and his enfeoffment was changed to Marquis of Luxiang County.
translations.idiomatic: He still followed Gao Huan into Luoyang, was appointed grand general of chariots and cavalry, and his enfeoffment was changed to marquis of Luxiang County.

sentences.zh: 天平中，除使持節、廣州軍事。

translations.literal: During Tianping he was appointed Bearer of the Staff of Authority with authority over military affairs in Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianping he was appointed bearer of the staff of authority with authority over military affairs in Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 梁遣將湛僧珍、楊暕來寇，懷與行臺元晏擊項城，拔之，擒暕。

translations.literal: Liang sent generals Zhan Sengzhen and Yang Yan to raid; Huai together with mobile-circuit commissioner Yuan Yan attacked Xiangcheng, took it, and captured Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Liang sent generals Zhan Sengzhen and Yang Yan to raid; Wang Huai together with mobile-circuit commissioner Yuan Yan attacked Xiangcheng, took it, and captured Yan.

sentences.zh: 又從高祖襲克西夏州。

translations.literal: He again followed the Grand Ancestor in a surprise attack that captured Western Xia Province.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Gao Huan in a surprise attack that captured Western Xia Province.

sentences.zh: 還，為大都督，鎮下館，除儀同三司。

translations.literal: On returning, he became Grand Commander, garrisoned Xia Guan, and was appointed Commissioner with Protocol Equal to Three Imperators.
translations.idiomatic: On returning, he became grand commander, garrisoned Xia Guan, and was appointed commissioner with protocol equal to three imperators.

sentences.zh: 元象初，為大都督，與諸將西討，遇疾卒於建州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanxiang, he became Grand Commander and campaigned west with the various generals; he fell ill and died at Jian Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanxiang, he became grand commander and campaigned west with the various generals; he fell ill and died at Jian Province.

sentences.zh: 贈定幽恒肆四州諸軍事、刺史、司徒公、尚書僕射。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was granted authority over military affairs in the four provinces of Ding, You, Heng, and Si, plus governorship, Grand Steward, and Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted authority over military affairs in the four provinces of Ding, You, Heng, and Si, plus governorship, grand steward, and vice director of the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 懷以武藝勳誠為高祖所知，志力未申，論者惜其不遂。

translations.literal: Huai was known to the Grand Ancestor for his martial skill and loyal service; his ambitions were never fully realized, and commentators lamented that he did not fulfill his promise.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huai was known to Gao Huan for his martial skill and loyal service; his ambitions were never fully realized, and commentators lamented that he did not fulfill his promise.

sentences.zh: 皇建初，配饗高祖廟庭。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was granted a place in offerings at the Grand Ancestor's temple court.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was granted a place in offerings at Gao Huan's temple court.

sentences.zh: 劉貴，秀容陽曲人也。

translations.literal: Liu Gui was a native of Yangqu in Xiurong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gui was a native of Yangqu in Xiurong.

sentences.zh: 父幹，魏世贈前將軍、肆州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Gan was posthumously granted Front General and Governor of Si Province during Wei.
translations.idiomatic: His father Gan was posthumously granted front general and governor of Si Province during Wei.

sentences.zh: 貴剛格有氣斷，歷尒朱榮府騎兵參軍。

translations.literal: Gui was stern of character and decisive; he served successively as cavalry adjutant in Erzhu Rong's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gui was stern of character and decisive; he served successively as cavalry adjutant in Erzhu Rong's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 建義初，以預定策勛，封敷城縣伯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyi, for his part in planning and merit, he was enfeoffed Baron of Fucheng County with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianyi, for his part in planning and merit, he was enfeoffed baron of Fucheng County with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 除左將軍、太中大夫，尋進為公。

translations.literal: He was appointed Left General and Grand Master for Consultation, and soon was advanced to Duke.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed left general and grand master for consultation, and soon was advanced to duke.

sentences.zh: 榮性猛急，貴尤嚴峻，每見任使，多愜榮心，遂被信遇，位望日重，加撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: Rong's nature was fierce and impatient; Gui was especially stern and rigorous; whenever entrusted with a task he mostly satisfied Rong's wishes, and so won trust and favor — his status and reputation grew daily, and he was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Rong's nature was fierce and impatient; Liu Gui was especially stern and rigorous; whenever entrusted with a task he mostly satisfied Rong's wishes, and so won trust and favor — his status and reputation grew daily, and he was additionally made general who pacifies the army.

sentences.zh: 永安三年，除涼州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongan, he was appointed Governor of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongan, he was appointed governor of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 建明初，尒朱世隆專擅，以貴為征南將軍、金紫光祿、兼左僕射、西道行臺，使抗孝莊行臺元顯恭於正平。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianming, Erzhu Shilong held sole power and made Gui General Who Campaigns in the South, Bearer of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, concurrently Left Vice Director, and Commissioner of the Western Circuit, to oppose Emperor Xiaozhuang's mobile-circuit commissioner Yuan Xiangong at Zhengping.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianming, Erzhu Shilong held sole power and made Liu Gui general who campaigns in the south, bearer of the golden seal and purple ribbon, concurrently left vice director, and commissioner of the western circuit, to oppose Emperor Xiaozhuang's mobile-circuit commissioner Yuan Xiangong at Zhengping.

sentences.zh: 貴破顯恭，擒之，並大都督裴儁等，復除晉州刺史。

translations.literal: Gui defeated Xiangong, captured him together with Grand Commander Pei Jun and others, and was again appointed Governor of Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gui defeated Xiangong, captured him together with grand commander Pei Jun and others, and was again appointed governor of Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，轉行汾州事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai, he was transferred to administer Bing Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai, he was transferred to administer Bing Province affairs.

sentences.zh: 高祖起義，貴棄城歸高祖於鄴。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor raised righteousness, Gui abandoned his city and joined him at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan raised righteousness, Liu Gui abandoned his city and joined him at Ye.

sentences.zh: 太昌初，以本官除肆州刺史，轉行建州事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taichang, he was appointed Governor of Si Province in his existing rank and transferred to administer Jian Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taichang, he was appointed governor of Si Province in his existing rank and transferred to administer Jian Province affairs.

sentences.zh: 天平初，除陜州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianping, he was appointed Governor of Shan Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianping, he was appointed governor of Shan Province.

sentences.zh: 四年，除御史中尉、肆州大中正。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he was appointed Censor-in-Chief and Chief Arbiter of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, he was appointed censor-in-chief and chief arbiter of Si Province.

sentences.zh: 其年，加行臺僕射，與侯景、高昂等討獨孤如願於洛陽。

translations.literal: That same year, he was additionally made Mobile-Circuit Vice Director and, together with Hou Jing, Gao Ang, and others, campaigned against Dugu Ruyuan at Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, he was additionally made mobile-circuit vice director and, together with Hou Jing, Gao Ang, and others, campaigned against Dugu Ruyuan at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 任延敬，廣寧人也。

translations.literal: Ren Yanjing was a native of Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yanjing was a native of Guangning.

sentences.zh: 伯父桃，太和初為雲中軍將，延敬隨之，因家焉。

translations.literal: His uncle's elder brother Tao, at the beginning of Taihe, served as General of the Army at Yunzhong; Yanjing followed him and there established his household.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle's elder brother Tao, at the beginning of Taihe, served as general of the army at Yunzhong; Ren Yanjing followed him and there established his household.

sentences.zh: 延敬少和厚，有器度。

translations.literal: Yanjing from youth was mild and generous, with breadth of character.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yanjing from youth was mild and generous, with breadth of character.

sentences.zh: 初從葛榮為賊，榮署為王，甚見委任。

translations.literal: He initially followed Ge Rong as a bandit; Rong appointed him king and greatly entrusted him.
translations.idiomatic: He initially followed Ge Rong as a bandit; Ge Rong appointed him king and greatly entrusted him.

sentences.zh: 榮敗，延敬擁所部先降，拜鎮遠將軍、廣寧太守，賜爵西河縣公。

translations.literal: When Rong was defeated, Yanjing led his own troops in surrendering first and was appointed General Who Pacifies the Distant, Governor of Guangning, and enfeoffed Duke of Xihe County.
translations.idiomatic: When Ge Rong was defeated, Ren Yanjing led his own troops in surrendering first and was appointed general who pacifies the distant, governor of Guangning, and enfeoffed duke of Xihe County.

sentences.zh: 後隨高祖建義，中興初，累遷光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Later he followed the Grand Ancestor in raising righteousness; at the beginning of Zhongxing he was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Gao Huan in raising righteousness; at the beginning of Zhongxing he was repeatedly promoted to grand master of splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 太昌初，累轉尚書左僕射，進位開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taichang, he was repeatedly transferred to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and advanced to Commissioner of the First Rank with Protocol Equal to Three Imperators.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taichang, he was repeatedly transferred to left vice director of the masters of writing and advanced to commissioner of the first rank with protocol equal to three imperators.

sentences.zh: 延敬位望既重，能以寬和接物，人士稱之。

translations.literal: Yanjing's rank and reputation were already weighty, and he could treat others with forbearance and kindness — gentry and commoners alike praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yanjing's rank and reputation were already weighty, and he could treat others with forbearance and kindness — gentry and commoners alike praised him.

sentences.zh: 及斛斯椿釁發，延敬棄家北走，至河北郡，因率土民據之，以待高祖。

translations.literal: When Husi Chun's treachery broke out, Yanjing abandoned his household and fled north to Hebei Commandery, where he rallied the local people and held it, awaiting the Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: When Husi Chun's treachery broke out, Ren Yanjing abandoned his household and fled north to Hebei Commandery, where he rallied the local people and held it, awaiting Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 魏武帝入關，荊蠻不順，以延敬為持節南道大都督，討平之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu of Wei entered the Pass, the Jing barbarians were rebellious; Yanjing was appointed Bearer of the Staff with the title Grand Commander of the Southern Circuit and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Wei entered the Pass, the Jing barbarians were rebellious; Ren Yanjing was appointed bearer of the staff with the title grand commander of the southern circuit and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 天平初，復拜侍中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianping, he was again appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianping, he was again appointed attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 時范陽人盧仲延率河北流人反於陽夏，西兗州民田龍聚衆應之，以延敬為大都督、東道軍司，率都督元整、叱列陀等討之。

translations.literal: At that time Lu Zhongyan of Fanyang led displaced people of Hebei in rebellion at Yangxia, and Tian Long of Western Yan Province gathered a host in response; Yanjing was made Grand Commander and Military Coordinator of the Eastern Circuit and led Grand Commanders Yuan Zheng, Chilie Tuo, and others to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Lu Zhongyan of Fanyang led displaced people of Hebei in rebellion at Yangxia, and Tian Long of Western Yan Province gathered a host in response; Ren Yanjing was made grand commander and military coordinator of the eastern circuit and led grand commanders Yuan Zheng, Chilie Tuo, and others to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 尋為行臺僕射，除徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he became Mobile-Circuit Vice Director and was appointed Governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became mobile-circuit vice director and was appointed governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 時梁遣元慶和及其諸將寇邊，延敬破梁仁州刺史黃道始於北濟陰，又破梁儁於單父，俘斬萬人。

translations.literal: At that time Liang sent Yuan Qinghe and his generals to raid the frontier; Yanjing defeated Liang's Governor of Ren Province Huang Daoshi at Northern Jiyin and defeated Liang Jun at Shanfu, capturing and slaying ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liang sent Yuan Qinghe and his generals to raid the frontier; Ren Yanjing defeated Liang's governor of Ren Province Huang Daoshi at Northern Jiyin and defeated Liang Jun at Shanfu, capturing and slaying ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 又拜侍中。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 在州大有受納。

translations.literal: While administering the province he accepted large bribes.
translations.idiomatic: While administering the province he accepted large bribes.

sentences.zh: 然為政不殘，禮敬人士，不為民所疾苦。

translations.literal: Yet his governance was not cruel; he treated gentry with courtesy and respect, and the people did not suffer greatly under him.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his governance was not cruel; he treated gentry with courtesy and respect, and the people did not suffer greatly under him.

sentences.zh: 潁州長史賀若徽執刺史田迅據城降西魏，復令延敬率豫州刺史堯雄等討之。

translations.literal: He Ruo Hui, chief clerk of Ying Province, seized Governor Tian Xun, held the city, and surrendered to Western Wei; Yanjing was again ordered to lead Yuzhou Governor Yao Xiong and others against them.
translations.idiomatic: He Ruo Hui, chief clerk of Ying Province, seized Governor Tian Xun, held the city, and surrendered to Western Wei; Ren Yanjing was again ordered to lead Yuzhou Governor Yao Xiong and others against them.

sentences.zh: 西魏遣其將怡鋒率衆來援，延敬等與戰失利，收還北豫，仍與行臺侯景、司徒高昂等相會，共攻潁川，拔之。

translations.literal: Western Wei sent its general Yi Feng with troops to the rescue; Yanjing and the others were defeated in battle, withdrew to Northern Yu Province, then joined mobile-circuit commissioner Hou Jing, Grand Steward Gao Ang, and others, jointly attacked Yingchuan, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei sent its general Yi Feng with troops to the rescue; Ren Yanjing and the others were defeated in battle, withdrew to Northern Yu Province, then joined mobile-circuit commissioner Hou Jing, grand steward Gao Ang, and others, jointly attacked Yingchuan, and took it.

sentences.zh: 元象元年秋，卒於鄴，時年四十五。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Yuanxiang he died at Ye; he was forty-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the first year of Yuanxiang he died at Ye; he was forty-five.

sentences.zh: 贈使持節、太保、太尉公、錄尚書事、都督冀定瀛幽安五州諸軍事、冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was granted Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand Guardian, Grand Commandant, Overseer of Masters-of-Writing Affairs, and authority over military affairs in the five provinces of Ji, Ding, Ying, You, and An, plus governorship of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted bearer of the staff of authority, grand guardian, grand commandant, overseer of masters-of-writing affairs, and authority over military affairs in the five provinces of Ji, Ding, Ying, You, and An, plus governorship of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 子胄嗣。

translations.literal: His son Zhou succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhou succeeded.

sentences.zh: 胄輕俠，頗敏惠。

translations.literal: Zhou was dashing and chivalric, and fairly quick-witted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou was dashing and chivalric, and fairly quick-witted.

sentences.zh: 少在高祖左右，天平中，擢為東郡太守。

translations.literal: From youth he was at the Grand Ancestor's side; in the Tianping era he was promoted to Governor of Dong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was at Gao Huan's side; in the Tianping era he was promoted to governor of Dong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 家本豐財，又多聚斂，動極豪華，賓客往來，將迎至厚。

translations.literal: His household was already wealthy, and he also amassed riches; his manner was extremely extravagant, and guests who came and went were received with the greatest hospitality.
translations.idiomatic: His household was already wealthy, and he also amassed riches; his manner was extremely extravagant, and guests who came and went were received with the greatest hospitality.

sentences.zh: 尋以贓汚為有司所劾，高祖捨之。

translations.literal: Soon he was impeached for graft by the relevant offices, but the Grand Ancestor pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was impeached for graft by the relevant offices, but Gao Huan pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 及解郡，高祖以為都督。

translations.literal: When he left his commandery post, the Grand Ancestor made him a Grand Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When he left his commandery post, Gao Huan made him a grand commander.

sentences.zh: 興和末，高祖攻玉壁還，以晉州西南重要，留清河公嶽為行臺鎮守，以胄隸之。

translations.literal: At the end of Xinghe, when the Grand Ancestor returned from attacking Yubi, because southwestern Jin Province was strategically vital he left Duke of Qinghe Yue as mobile-circuit commissioner to garrison it, and Zhou was placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Xinghe, when Gao Huan returned from attacking Yubi, because southwestern Jin Province was strategically vital he left Duke of Qinghe Yue as mobile-circuit commissioner to garrison it, and Zhou was placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 胄飲酒遊縱，不勤防守，高祖責之。

translations.literal: Zhou drank and roamed at leisure, failing to keep vigilant guard; the Grand Ancestor reprimanded him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou drank and roamed at leisure, failing to keep vigilant guard; Gao Huan reprimanded him.

sentences.zh: 胄懼，遂潛遣使送款於周。

translations.literal: Zhou was afraid and secretly sent envoys to offer submission to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou was afraid and secretly sent envoys to offer submission to Northern Zhou.

sentences.zh: 為人糾列，窮治未得其實，高祖特免之，謂胄曰：「我推誠於物，謂卿必無此理。

translations.literal: Someone reported and denounced him; though investigation pursued to the end no proof was found, and the Grand Ancestor specially pardoned him, saying to Zhou: "I extend sincerity toward all things and believed you could surely have no such design.
translations.idiomatic: Someone reported and denounced him; though investigation pursued to the end no proof was found, and Gao Huan specially pardoned him, saying to Zhou: "I extend sincerity toward all things and believed you could surely have no such design.

sentences.zh: 且黑獺降人，首尾相繼，卿之虛實，於後何患不知。

translations.literal: Moreover, Yuwen Tai's surrendered men come one after another — whether your conduct is true or false, why fear it will not be known afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Yuwen Tai's surrendered men come one after another — whether your conduct is true or false, why fear it will not be known afterward.

sentences.zh: 」胄內不自安。

translations.literal: " Zhou inwardly could not rest at ease.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhou inwardly could not rest at ease.

sentences.zh: 是時，儀同尒朱文暢及參軍房子遠、鄭仲禮等並險薄無賴，胄厚與交結，乃陰圖殺逆。

translations.literal: At that time Commissioner with Protocol Equal to Three Imperators Erzhu Wenchang, adjutants Fang Ziyuan, Zheng Zhongli, and others were all treacherous, base, and worthless; Zhou cultivated close ties with them and secretly plotted regicide.
translations.idiomatic: At that time commissioner with protocol equal to three imperators Erzhu Wenchang, adjutants Fang Ziyuan, Zheng Zhongli, and others were all treacherous, base, and worthless; Zhou cultivated close ties with them and secretly plotted regicide.

sentences.zh: 武定三年正月十五日，因高祖夜戲，謀將竊發。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day of the first month in the third year of Wuding, taking advantage of the Grand Ancestor's nightly entertainments, they plotted to strike by surprise.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth day of the first month in the third year of Wuding, taking advantage of Gao Huan's nightly entertainments, they plotted to strike by surprise.

sentences.zh: 有人告之，令捕窮治，事皆得實。

translations.literal: Someone reported them; an order went out to arrest and investigate to the end, and everything was confirmed.
translations.idiomatic: Someone reported them; an order went out to arrest and investigate to the end, and everything was confirmed.

sentences.zh: 胄及子弟並誅。

translations.literal: Zhou and his sons and younger brothers were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou and his sons and younger brothers were all executed.

sentences.zh: 莫多婁貸文，太安狄那人也。

translations.literal: Moduoluo Daiwen was a native of Dina in Tai'an.
translations.idiomatic: Moduoluo Daiwen was a native of Dina in Tai'an.

sentences.zh: 驍果有膽氣。

translations.literal: He was fierce and resolute, with courage and mettle.
translations.idiomatic: He was fierce and resolute, with courage and mettle.

sentences.zh: 從高祖舉義。

translations.literal: He followed the Grand Ancestor in raising righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Gao Huan in raising righteousness.

sentences.zh: 中興初，除伏波將軍、武賁中郎將、虞候大都督。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhongxing, he was appointed General Who Calms the Waves, Gentlemen-at-Arms Central Palace Guard, and Grand Commander of the Guard Corps.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhongxing, he was appointed general who calms the waves, gentlemen-at-arms central palace guard, and grand commander of the guard corps.

sentences.zh: 從擊尒朱兆於廣阿，有功，加前將軍，封石城縣子，邑三百戶。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a, performed meritorious service, was additionally made Front General, and enfeoffed Viscount of Shicheng County with a fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the campaign against Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a, performed meritorious service, was additionally made front general, and enfeoffed viscount of Shicheng County with a fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 又從破四胡於韓陵，進爵為侯。

translations.literal: He again followed in defeating the Four Huns at Hanling and his rank was advanced to Marquis.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed in defeating the Four Huns at Hanling and his rank was advanced to marquis.

sentences.zh: 從平尒朱兆於赤谼嶺。

translations.literal: He followed in pacifying Erzhu Zhao at Chihong Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: He followed in pacifying Erzhu Zhao at Chihong Ridge.

sentences.zh: 兆窮迫自經，貸文獲其屍。

translations.literal: Zhao, driven to desperation, hanged himself; Daiwen recovered his corpse.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Zhao, driven to desperation, hanged himself; Daiwen recovered his corpse.

sentences.zh: 遷左廂大都督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Grand Commander of the Left Wing.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to grand commander of the left wing.

sentences.zh: 斛斯椿等釁起，魏武帝遣賈顯智據守石濟。

translations.literal: When Husi Chun and others' treachery erupted, Emperor Wu of Wei sent Jia Xianzhi to hold and garrison Shiji.
translations.idiomatic: When Husi Chun and others' treachery erupted, Emperor Wu of Wei sent Jia Xianzhi to hold and garrison Shiji.

sentences.zh: 高祖令貸文率精銳三萬，與竇泰等於定州相會，同趣石濟，擊走顯智。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor ordered Daiwen to lead thirty thousand picked troops, join Dou Tai and others at Ding Province, march together on Shiji, and drive off Xianzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan ordered Daiwen to lead thirty thousand picked troops, join Dou Tai and others at Ding Province, march together on Shiji, and drive off Xianzhi.

sentences.zh: 天平中，除晉州刺史。

translations.literal: During Tianping he was appointed Governor of Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianping he was appointed governor of Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 汾州胡賊為寇竊，高祖親討焉，以貸文為先鋒，每有戰功。

translations.literal: When Hu bandits of Bing Province raided and plundered, the Grand Ancestor personally campaigned against them, made Daiwen his vanguard, and he repeatedly won distinction in battle.
translations.idiomatic: When Hu bandits of Bing Province raided and plundered, Gao Huan personally campaigned against them, made Daiwen his vanguard, and he repeatedly won distinction in battle.

sentences.zh: 還，賚奴婢三十人、牛馬各五十匹、布一千匹，仍為汾、陜、東雍、晉、泰五州大都督。

translations.literal: On returning, he was awarded thirty male and female servants, fifty head of cattle and horses each, and a thousand bolts of cloth, and was additionally made Grand Commander over the five provinces of Fen, Shan, Eastern Yong, Jin, and Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On returning, he was awarded thirty male and female servants, fifty head of cattle and horses each, and a thousand bolts of cloth, and was additionally made grand commander over the five provinces of Fen, Shan, Eastern Yong, Jin, and Tai.

sentences.zh: 後與太保尉景攻東雍、南汾二州，克之。

translations.literal: Later he together with Grand Guardian Wei Jing attacked the two provinces of Eastern Yong and Southern Fen and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: Later he together with grand guardian Wei Jing attacked the two provinces of Eastern Yong and Southern Fen and captured them.

sentences.zh: 元象初，除車騎大將軍、儀同、南道大都督，與行臺侯景攻獨孤如願於金墉城。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanxiang, he was appointed Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Commissioner with Protocol Equal to Three Imperators, Grand Commander of the Southern Circuit, and together with mobile-circuit commissioner Hou Jing attacked Dugu Ruyuan at Jinyong City.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanxiang, he was appointed grand general of chariots and cavalry, commissioner with protocol equal to three imperators, grand commander of the southern circuit, and together with mobile-circuit commissioner Hou Jing attacked Dugu Ruyuan at Jinyong City.

sentences.zh: 周文帝軍出函谷，景與高昂議整旅厲卒，以待其至。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Zhou's army came out through Hangu Pass, Jing and Gao Ang discussed marshaling the host and hardening the troops to await his arrival.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Zhou's army came out through Hangu Pass, Hou Jing and Gao Ang discussed marshaling the host and hardening the troops to await his arrival.

sentences.zh: 貸文請率所部，擊其前鋒，景等固不許。

translations.literal: Daiwen asked to lead his own troops to strike their vanguard, but Jing and the others firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: Daiwen asked to lead his own troops to strike their vanguard, but Hou Jing and the others firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 貸文性勇而專，不肯受命，以輕騎一千軍前斥候，西過瀍澗，遇周軍，戰沒。

translations.literal: Daiwen's nature was brave and willful; refusing to accept orders, he took a thousand light cavalry on forward reconnaissance, passed west beyond the Chan Stream, encountered Zhou troops, and fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Daiwen's nature was brave and willful; refusing to accept orders, he took a thousand light cavalry on forward reconnaissance, passed west beyond the Chan Stream, encountered Zhou troops, and fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 贈幷肆恒雲朔五州軍事、幷州刺史、尚書右僕射、司徒公。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was granted military authority over the five provinces of Bing, Si, Heng, Yun, and Shuo, governorship of Bing Province, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Grand Steward.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted military authority over the five provinces of Bing, Si, Heng, Yun, and Shuo, governorship of Bing Province, right vice director of the masters of writing, and grand steward.

sentences.zh: 子敬顯，強直勤幹，少以武力見知。

translations.literal: His son Jingxian was upright, diligent, and capable; from youth he won notice for his martial prowess.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jingxian was upright, diligent, and capable; from youth he won notice for his martial prowess.

sentences.zh: 恒從斛律光征討，數有戰功。

translations.literal: He constantly followed Hulü Guang on campaign and repeatedly won distinction.
translations.idiomatic: He constantly followed Hulü Guang on campaign and repeatedly won distinction.

sentences.zh: 光每命敬顯前驅，安置營壘，夜中巡察，或達旦不睡。

translations.literal: Guang always ordered Jingxian to lead the van, set up camps and fortifications, and patrol at night — sometimes going until dawn without sleep.
translations.idiomatic: Hulü Guang always ordered Jingxian to lead the van, set up camps and fortifications, and patrol at night — sometimes going until dawn without sleep.

sentences.zh: 臨敵置陳，亦令敬顯部分將士，造次之間，行伍整肅。

translations.literal: When facing the enemy and deploying battle arrays, he also had Jingxian assign ranks to officers and soldiers; in the blink of an eye the lines stood in perfect order.
translations.idiomatic: When facing the enemy and deploying battle arrays, he also had Jingxian assign ranks to officers and soldiers; in the blink of an eye the lines stood in perfect order.

sentences.zh: 深為光所重。

translations.literal: Guang held him in deep esteem.
translations.idiomatic: Hulü Guang held him in deep esteem.

sentences.zh: 位至領軍將軍，恒檢校虞候事。

translations.literal: He rose to the rank of General of the Guards and was constantly charged with inspecting guard-corps affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to the rank of general of the guards and was constantly charged with inspecting guard-corps affairs.

sentences.zh: 武平中，車駕幸晉陽，每令敬顯督留臺兵馬，糾察盜賊，京師肅然。

translations.literal: In the Wuping era, when the imperial carriage went to Jinyang, Jingxian was regularly ordered to supervise the capital's remaining troops and horses, investigate thieves and robbers — the capital grew solemn and orderly.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wuping era, when the imperial carriage went to Jinyang, Jingxian was regularly ordered to supervise the capital's remaining troops and horses, investigate thieves and robbers — the capital grew solemn and orderly.

sentences.zh: 七年，從後主平陽，敗歸幷州，與唐邕等推立安德王稱尊號。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he followed the Late Emperor to Pingyang, was defeated and returned to Bing Province, and together with Tang Yong and others installed Prince of Ande and proclaimed him sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, he followed the Late Emperor to Pingyang, was defeated and returned to Bing Province, and together with Tang Yong and others installed Prince of Ande and proclaimed him sovereign.

sentences.zh: 安德敗，文武羣官皆投周軍，唯敬顯走還鄴。

translations.literal: When Prince of Ande was defeated, civil and military officials all went over to the Zhou army — only Jingxian fled back to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince of Ande was defeated, civil and military officials all went over to the Zhou army — only Jingxian fled back to Ye.

sentences.zh: 授司徒。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Steward.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed grand steward.

sentences.zh: 周武帝平鄴城之明日，執敬顯，斬於閶闔門外，責其不留晉陽也。

translations.literal: The day after Emperor Wu of Zhou pacified Ye city, Jingxian was seized and executed outside the Changhe Gate, blamed for not remaining at Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: The day after Emperor Wu of Zhou took Ye, Jingxian was seized and beheaded outside the Changhe Gate — punished for failing to hold Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 高市貴，善無人也。

translations.literal: Gao Shigui was a native of Shanwu.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Shigui was a man of Shanwu.

sentences.zh: 少有武用。

translations.literal: From youth he had martial ability.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he had a soldier's gift.

sentences.zh: 孝昌初，恒州內部勅勒劉侖等聚衆反，市貴為都督，率衆討侖，一戰破之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xiaochang, Liu Lun and others of the Chile tribe within Heng Province gathered crowds in rebellion; Shigui served as commander, led troops to attack Lun, and defeated him in one battle.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiaochang, Liu Lun and other Chile tribesmen within Heng Province rose in rebellion. Shigui served as commander, led troops against Lun, and broke him in a single battle.

sentences.zh: 累遷撫軍將軍、諫議大夫。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to General Who Pacifies the Army and Remonstrance Advisor.
translations.idiomatic: He rose by stages to general who pacifies the army and remonstrance advisor.

sentences.zh: 及尒朱榮立魏莊帝，高貴預翼戴之勳，遷衛將軍、光祿大夫、秀容大都督、第一領民酋長，賜爵上洛縣伯。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong enthroned Emperor Zhuang of Wei, Shigui shared in the merit of supporting the throne; he was transferred to Guard General, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Grand Commander of Xiurong, First Chieftain of Registered Tribal Peoples, and enfeoffed Baron of Shangluo County.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong enthroned Emperor Zhuang of Wei, Shigui shared in the merit of raising him up and was made guard general, grand master of splendid happiness, grand commander of Xiurong, first chieftain of registered tribal peoples, and baron of Shangluo County.

sentences.zh: 尒朱榮擊葛榮於滏口，以市貴為前鋒都督。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong attacked Ge Rong at Fukou, Shigui was made vanguard commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong struck Ge Rong at Fukou, Shigui was made vanguard commander.

sentences.zh: 榮平，除使持節、汾州刺史，尋為晉州刺史。

translations.literal: When Rong was pacified, he was appointed Commissioner with Full Powers and Governor of Fen Province; soon he became Governor of Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: After Rong was pacified, he was appointed commissioner with full powers and governor of Fen Province; soon he became governor of Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 紇豆陵步藩之侵亂幷州也，高祖破之，市貴亦從行有功，除驃騎大將軍、儀同三司，封常山郡公，邑一千五百戶。

translations.literal: When Heduoling Bufan invaded and harassed Bing Province, the Grand Ancestor defeated him; Shigui also followed on campaign with merit and was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Senior Grand Master of Equal Rank with the Three Dukes, enfeoffed Duke of Changshan Commandery with a fief of one thousand five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Heduoling Bufan raided Bing Province, Gao Huan broke him; Shigui followed on campaign with merit and was made grand general of agile cavalry, senior grand master equal in rank to the three dukes, and duke of Changshan Commandery with a fief of fifteen hundred households.

sentences.zh: 高祖起義，市貴預其謀。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor raised the standard of revolt, Shigui took part in the planning.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan raised the standard of revolt, Shigui took part in the planning.

sentences.zh: 及樊子鵠據州反，隨大都督婁昭討之。

translations.literal: When Fan Ziguo seized the province in rebellion, he followed Grand Commander Lou Zhao to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: When Fan Ziguo seized the province in rebellion, he followed Grand Commander Lou Zhao to put him down.

sentences.zh: 子鵠平，除西兗州刺史，不之州。

translations.literal: When Ziguo was pacified, he was made Governor of Western Yan Province but did not go to the province.
translations.idiomatic: When Ziguo was pacified, he was made governor of Western Yan Province but never took up the post.

sentences.zh: 天平初，復除晉州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianping, he was again appointed Governor of Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianping he was again appointed governor of Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 高祖尋以洪峒要險，遣市貴鎮之。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor soon, because Hongdong was strategically crucial, dispatched Shigui to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan soon sent Shigui to hold Hongdong, a place of critical terrain.

sentences.zh: 高祖沙苑失利，晉州行事封祖業棄城而還，州民柴覽聚衆作逆。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor suffered defeat at Shaya, the acting governor of Jin Province Feng Zuye abandoned the city and fled back; provincial resident Chai Lan gathered crowds in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan lost at Shaya, Feng Zuye, acting governor of Jin Province, abandoned the city and fled; the provincial man Chai Lan gathered a crowd and rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 高祖命市貴討覽，覽奔柴壁，市貴破斬之。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor ordered Shigui to attack Lan; Lan fled to Chai Fortress; Shigui defeated and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan ordered Shigui against Lan. Lan fled to Chai Fortress; Shigui broke him there and cut off his head.

sentences.zh: 是時，東雍、南汾二州境多群賊，聚為盜，因市貴平覽，皆散歸復業。

translations.literal: At that time the territory of Eastern Yong and Southern Fen provinces had many bandit groups gathering as robbers; because Shigui pacified Lan, they all dispersed and returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Eastern Yong and Southern Fen were thick with bandits who had gathered into robber bands; once Shigui pacified Lan, they scattered and returned to their fields.

sentences.zh: 後秀容人五千戶叛應山胡，復以市貴為行臺，統諸軍討平之。

translations.literal: Later five thousand households of Xiurong rebelled in response to the Shanhu; Shigui was again made Mobile Office commander, commanding various armies to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Later five thousand Xiurong households rebelled in answer to the Shanhu. Shigui was again made mobile-office commander and led the armies that suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 元象中，從高祖破周文帝於邙山。

translations.literal: In the Yuanxiang era, he followed the Grand Ancestor in defeating Emperor Wen of Zhou at Mount Mang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanxiang era he followed Gao Huan in defeating Emperor Wen of Zhou at Mount Mang.

sentences.zh: 重除晉州刺史、西道軍司，率衆擊懷州逆賊潘集。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Governor of Jin Province and Western Circuit Army Marshal, leading troops to attack the rebel Pan Ji of Huai Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made governor of Jin Province and western-circuit army marshal, leading troops against the Huai Province rebel Pan Ji.

sentences.zh: 未至，遇疾道卒。

translations.literal: Before he arrived, he fell ill and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Before he arrived he fell ill and died on the road.

sentences.zh: 贈幷汾懷建東雍五州軍事、太尉公、幷州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Commander-in-Chief of Military Affairs for the five provinces of Bing, Fen, Huai, Jian, and Eastern Yong, Duke Grand Commandant, Governor of Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted commander-in-chief of military affairs for Bing, Fen, Huai, Jian, and Eastern Yong, duke grand commandant, and governor of Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 子可那肱貴寵，封成臯王。

translations.literal: His son Kenazhu enjoyed high favor and was enfeoffed Prince of Chenggao.
translations.idiomatic: His son Kenazhu rose in high favor and was enfeoffed Prince of Chenggao.

sentences.zh: 勑令其第二子孔雀承襲。

translations.literal: An edict ordered his second son Kongque to inherit the title.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered his second son Kongque to inherit the title.

sentences.zh: 厙狄迴洛，代人也。

translations.literal: Kudi Huiluo was a native of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Kudi Huiluo was a man of Dai.

sentences.zh: 少有武力，儀貌魁偉。

translations.literal: From youth he had martial strength; his bearing and appearance were imposing.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he had martial strength, and his bearing and frame were imposing.

sentences.zh: 初事尒朱榮為統軍，預立莊帝，轉為別將，賜爵毋極伯。

translations.literal: At first he served Erzhu Rong as army commander, took part in enthroning Emperor Zhuang, was transferred to separate commander, and enfeoffed Baron of Wuji.
translations.idiomatic: At first he served Erzhu Rong as army commander, took part in enthroning Emperor Zhuang, was transferred to separate commander, and enfeoffed baron of Wuji.

sentences.zh: 從破葛榮，轉都督。

translations.literal: Following the defeat of Ge Rong, he was transferred to commander.
translations.idiomatic: After Ge Rong was broken, he was transferred to commander.

sentences.zh: 榮死，隸尒朱兆。

translations.literal: When Rong died, he came under Erzhu Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: When Rong died, he passed to Erzhu Zhao.

sentences.zh: 高祖舉兵信都，迴洛擁衆歸義。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor raised troops at Xindu, Huiluo brought his followers and submitted in loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan raised troops at Xindu, Huiluo brought his followers over in loyalty.

sentences.zh: 從破四胡於韓陵，以軍功補都督，加後將軍、太中大夫，封順陽縣子，邑四百戶。

translations.literal: Following the defeat of the Four Hus at Hanling, for military merit he was made commander, additionally Rear General and Grand Master of Palace Counsel, enfeoffed Viscount of Shunyang County with a fief of four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: After the Four Hus were broken at Hanling, he was made commander for military merit, additionally rear general and grand master of palace counsel, and enfeoffed viscount of Shunyang County with four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 遷右廂都督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to right-wing commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to right-wing commander.

sentences.zh: 從征山胡，先鋒斬級，除朔州刺史。

translations.literal: Campaigning against the Shanhu, as vanguard he severed heads; he was appointed Governor of Shuo Province.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign against the Shanhu he served as vanguard and took heads; he was appointed governor of Shuo Province.

sentences.zh: 破周文於河陽，轉授夏州刺史。

translations.literal: He defeated Zhou Wen at Heyang and was transferred and granted Governor of Xia Province.
