translations.idiomatic: He defeated Zhou Wen at Heyang and was transferred to governor of Xia Province.

sentences.zh: 邙山之役，力戰有功，增邑通前七百戶。

translations.literal: At the Battle of Mount Mang, he fought hard with merit; his fief was increased to seven hundred households in all with previous holdings.
translations.idiomatic: At Mount Mang he fought hard with merit; his fief was increased to seven hundred households in all.

sentences.zh: 世宗嗣事，從平潁川。

translations.literal: When Shizong succeeded to affairs, he followed in pacifying Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Cheng succeeded to affairs, he followed in pacifying Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 天保初，除建州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, he was appointed Governor of Jian Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao he was appointed governor of Jian Province.

sentences.zh: 肅宗即位，封順陽郡王。

translations.literal: When Emperor Suzong took the throne, he was enfeoffed Prince of Shunyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Suzong took the throne, he was enfeoffed Prince of Shunyang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 大寧初，轉朔州刺史，食博陵郡幹。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daning, he was transferred to Governor of Shuo Province, drawing income from Boling Commandery dry rations.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Daning he was transferred to governor of Shuo Province, drawing income from Boling Commandery dry rations.

sentences.zh: 轉太子太師，遇疾卒。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; he fell ill and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to grand tutor of the crown prince, fell ill, and died.

sentences.zh: 贈使持節、都督定瀛恒朔雲五州軍事、大將軍、太尉公、定州刺史，贈物一千段。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Commissioner with Full Powers, Commander-in-Chief of Military Affairs for the five provinces of Ding, Ying, Heng, Shuo, and Yun, Grand General, Duke Grand Commandant, Governor of Ding Province, with one thousand rolls of gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted commissioner with full powers, commander-in-chief of military affairs for Ding, Ying, Heng, Shuo, and Yun, grand general, duke grand commandant, and governor of Ding Province, with one thousand rolls of gifts.

sentences.zh: 厙狄盛，懷朔人也。

translations.literal: Kudi Sheng was a native of Huaishuo.
translations.idiomatic: Kudi Sheng was a man of Huaishuo.

sentences.zh: 性和柔，少有武用。

translations.literal: His nature was gentle and yielding; from youth he had martial ability.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was gentle and yielding, yet from youth he had martial ability.

sentences.zh: 初為高祖親信都督，除伏波將軍，每從征討。

translations.literal: At first he was the Grand Ancestor's trusted personal commander, appointed General Who Quells Waves, and always followed on campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: At first he was Gao Huan's trusted personal commander, appointed general who quells waves, and always followed on campaign.

sentences.zh: 以功封行唐縣伯，復累加安北將軍，幽州刺史，加中軍將軍，為豫州鎮城都督。

translations.literal: For merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Xingtang County, repeatedly promoted to General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of You Province, additionally made Central Army General and fortress garrison commander of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was enfeoffed baron of Xingtang County, then repeatedly promoted to general who pacifies the north and governor of You Province, additionally made central army general and fortress garrison commander of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 以勳舊進爵為公，世宗減封二百戶，以增其邑。

translations.literal: As an old merit-holder he was advanced to duke; Shizong reduced the fief by two hundred households to increase his fief.
translations.idiomatic: As an old merit-holder he was advanced to duke; Gao Cheng reduced other fiefs by two hundred households to augment his.

sentences.zh: 除征西大將軍、開府儀同三司、朔州刺史。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand General Who Conquers the West, Senior Grand Master of State with Full Powers Equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Shuo Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed grand general who conquers the west, senior grand master of state with full powers equal to the three dukes, and governor of Shuo Province.

sentences.zh: 齊受禪，改封華陽縣公。

translations.literal: When Qi received the abdication, his title was changed to Duke of Huayang County.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi received the abdication, his title was changed to duke of Huayang County.

sentences.zh: 又除北朔州刺史，以華陽封邑在遠，隨例割幷州之石艾縣、肆州之平寇縣、原平之馬邑縣各數十戶，合二百戶為其食邑。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Governor of Northern Shuo Province; because his Huayang fief was far away, by precedent portions were cut from Shi'ai County of Bing Province, Pingkou County of Si Province, and Mayi County of Yuanping, several tens of households each, totaling two hundred households as his food fief.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed governor of Northern Shuo Province. Because his Huayang fief lay far away, by precedent several tens of households each were cut from Shi'ai County in Bing Province, Pingkou County in Si Province, and Mayi County in Yuanping — two hundred households in all — as his food fief.

sentences.zh: 未幾，例罷，拜特進，卒。

translations.literal: Before long, by precedent dismissed, he was appointed Special Advancement and died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, by precedent dismissed from provincial office, he was appointed special advancement and died.

sentences.zh: 贈使持節、都督朔瀛趙幽安五州諸軍事、太尉公、朔州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Commissioner with Full Powers, Commander-in-Chief of Military Affairs for the five provinces of Shuo, Ying, Zhao, You, and An, Duke Grand Commandant, Governor of Shuo Province.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted commissioner with full powers, commander-in-chief of military affairs for Shuo, Ying, Zhao, You, and An, duke grand commandant, and governor of Shuo Province.

sentences.zh: 薛孤延，代人也。

translations.literal: Xue Guyan was a native of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Guyan was a man of Dai.

sentences.zh: 少驍果，有武力。

translations.literal: From youth he was bold and resolute, with martial strength.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was bold and resolute, with a soldier's strength.

sentences.zh: 韓樓之反，延隨衆屬焉。

translations.literal: When Han Lou rebelled, Yan followed the crowd and submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Lou rebelled, Guyan followed the crowd and submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 後與王懷等密計討樓，為樓尉帥乙弗醜所覺，力戰破醜，遂相率歸。

translations.literal: Later he secretly plotted with Wang Huai and others to attack Lou; Lou's commandery captain Yifu Chou detected it; they fought hard and defeated Chou, then together led their followers back.
translations.idiomatic: Later he secretly plotted with Wang Huai and others to attack Lou. Lou's commandery captain Yifu Chou discovered it; they fought hard, broke Chou, and together led their followers back.

sentences.zh: 行臺劉貴表為都督，加征虜將軍，賜爵永固縣侯。

translations.literal: Mobile Office Liu Gui memorialized to make him commander, additionally General Who Captures Barbarians, enfeoffed Marquis of Yonggu County.
translations.idiomatic: Mobile-office Liu Gui memorialized to make him commander, additionally general who captures barbarians, and enfeoffed him marquis of Yonggu County.

sentences.zh: 後隸高祖為都督，仍從起義。

translations.literal: Later he came under the Grand Ancestor as commander and still followed in raising the revolt.
translations.idiomatic: Later he came under Gao Huan as commander and still followed in raising the revolt.

sentences.zh: 破尒朱兆於廣阿，因從平鄴，以功進爵為公，轉大都督。

translations.literal: He defeated Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a, followed in pacifying Ye; for merit he was advanced to duke and transferred to grand commander.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a and followed in pacifying Ye; for merit he was advanced to duke and transferred to grand commander.

sentences.zh: 從破四胡於韓陵，加金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: He followed in defeating the Four Hus at Hanling and was made Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Girdle.
translations.idiomatic: He followed in defeating the Four Hus at Hanling and was made grand master of the golden seal and purple girdle.

sentences.zh: 從追尒朱兆於赤谼嶺，除第一領民酋長。

translations.literal: He followed in pursuing Erzhu Zhao at Chihong Ridge and was appointed First Chieftain of Registered Tribal Peoples.
translations.idiomatic: He followed in pursuing Erzhu Zhao at Chihong Ridge and was appointed first chieftain of registered tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 孝靜立，拜顯州刺史，累加車騎將軍。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaojing was enthroned, he was appointed Governor of Xian Province and repeatedly promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaojing was enthroned, he was appointed governor of Xian Province and repeatedly promoted to general of chariots and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 天平四年，從高祖西伐。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianping, he followed the Grand Ancestor on the western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tianping he followed Gao Huan on the western campaign.

sentences.zh: 至蒲津，竇泰於河南失利，高祖班師，延殿後，且戰且行，一日斫折刀十五口。

translations.literal: Reaching Pujin, Dou Tai suffered defeat south of the river at Henan; the Grand Ancestor withdrew; Yan served as rearguard, fighting as they went; in one day he broke fifteen sword blades.
translations.idiomatic: At Pujin, Dou Tai was defeated south of the river in Henan; Gao Huan withdrew. Guyan served as rearguard, fighting as he went — in one day he broke fifteen sword blades.

sentences.zh: 還，轉梁州刺史。

translations.literal: On return, he was transferred to Governor of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was transferred to governor of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 從征玉壁，又轉恒州刺史。

translations.literal: Following the campaign against Yubi, he was again transferred to Governor of Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: Following the campaign against Yubi, he was again transferred to governor of Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 從破周文帝於邙山，進爵為縣公，邑一千戶。

translations.literal: He followed in defeating Emperor Wen of Zhou at Mount Mang, was advanced to commandery duke with a fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: He followed in defeating Emperor Wen of Zhou at Mount Mang and was advanced to commandery duke with a fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 高祖嘗閱馬於北牧，道逢暴雨，大雷震地。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor once inspected horses at the northern pasture; on the road they encountered torrential rain, great thunder shaking the earth.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan once inspected horses at the northern pasture. On the road they met torrential rain and thunder that shook the earth.

sentences.zh: 前有浮圖一所，高祖令延視之。

translations.literal: Ahead was a pagoda; the Grand Ancestor ordered Yan to go inspect it.
translations.idiomatic: Ahead stood a pagoda; Gao Huan ordered Guyan to go inspect it.

sentences.zh: 延乃馳馬按槊直前，未至三十步，雷火燒面，延喝殺，繞浮圖走，火遂滅。

translations.literal: Yan galloped forward spear in hand; before reaching thirty paces, lightning fire burned his face; Yan shouted and charged, circled the pagoda running, and the fire then extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Guyan galloped forward spear in hand. Before he had gone thirty paces, lightning fire burned his face; he shouted and charged, circled the pagoda at a run, and the fire went out.

sentences.zh: 延還，眉鬢及馬鬃尾俱焦。

translations.literal: When Yan returned, eyebrows, sideburns, and the horse's mane and tail were all singed.
translations.idiomatic: When Guyan returned, his brows, sideburns, and the horse's mane and tail were all singed.

sentences.zh: 高祖嘆曰：「薛孤延乃能與霹靂鬭！

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor sighed: "Xue Guyan can actually fight with thunderbolts!
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan sighed: "Xue Guyan can actually fight thunderbolts!

sentences.zh: 」其勇決如此。

translations.literal: " Such was his valor and resolution.
translations.idiomatic: " Such was his valor and resolution.

sentences.zh: 又頻從高祖討破山胡，西攻玉壁。

translations.literal: He also repeatedly followed the Grand Ancestor in defeating the Shanhu and attacking Yubi in the west.
translations.idiomatic: He also repeatedly followed Gao Huan in defeating the Shanhu and attacking Yubi in the west.

sentences.zh: 入為左衛將軍，改封平秦郡公。

translations.literal: He entered court as Left Guard General; his title was changed to Duke of Pingqin Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as left guard general and was re-enfeoffed duke of Pingqin Commandery.

sentences.zh: 為左廂大都督，與諸軍將討潁州。

translations.literal: He served as Grand Commander of the Left Wing, with various generals attacking Ying Province.
translations.idiomatic: He served as grand commander of the left wing, with the other generals attacking Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 延專監造土山，以酒醉為敵所襲據。

translations.literal: Yan was solely supervising construction of the earthen siege mound; being drunk on wine, the enemy seized it in a raid.
translations.idiomatic: Guyan was solely supervising construction of the earthen siege mound; drunk on wine, he let the enemy seize it in a raid.

sentences.zh: 潁州平，諸將還京師，讌於華林園。

translations.literal: When Ying Province was pacified, the generals returned to the capital and feasted in Hualin Park.
translations.idiomatic: When Ying Province was pacified, the generals returned to the capital and feasted in Hualin Park.

sentences.zh: 世宗啟魏帝，坐延於階下以辱之。

translations.literal: Shizong reported to the Wei Emperor and had Yan seated on the steps below to humiliate him.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Cheng reported to the Wei emperor and had Guyan seated on the steps below to humiliate him.

sentences.zh: 後兼領軍將軍，出為滄州刺史，別封溫縣男，邑三百戶。

translations.literal: Later he additionally held the post of General Who Leads the Army, went out as Governor of Cang Province, and was separately enfeoffed Baron of Wen County with a fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Later he additionally held the post of general who leads the army, went out as governor of Cang Province, and was separately enfeoffed baron of Wen County with three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 齊受禪，別賜爵都昌縣公。

translations.literal: When Qi received the abdication, he was separately granted title Duke of Duchang County.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi received the abdication, he was separately granted the title duke of Duchang County.

sentences.zh: 性好酒，率多昏醉。

translations.literal: His nature loved wine; mostly he was drunk and muddled.
translations.idiomatic: He loved wine by nature and was most often drunk and muddled.

sentences.zh: 而以勇決善戰，每大軍征討，常為前鋒，故與彭、劉、韓、潘同列。

translations.literal: Yet because of his valor, resolution, and skill in battle, whenever the great army marched on campaign he was always vanguard — thus ranked with Peng, Liu, Han, and Pan.
translations.idiomatic: Yet for his valor, resolution, and skill in battle, whenever the great army marched he was always vanguard — and so ranked with Peng, Liu, Han, and Pan.

sentences.zh: 天保二年，為太子太保，轉太子太傅。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianbao, he was made Grand Mentor of the Crown Prince and transferred to Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianbao he was made grand mentor of the crown prince, then transferred to grand tutor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 八年，除肆州刺史，加開府儀同三司，食洛陽郡幹，尋改食河間郡幹。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was appointed Governor of Si Province, additionally Senior Grand Master of State with Full Powers Equal to the Three Dukes, drawing income from Luoyang Commandery dry rations; soon changed to draw from Hejian Commandery dry rations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed governor of Si Province, additionally senior grand master of state with full powers equal to the three dukes, drawing income from Luoyang Commandery dry rations; soon changed to Hejian Commandery dry rations.

sentences.zh: 張保洛，代人也，自云本出南陽西鄂。

translations.literal: Zhang Baoluo was a native of Dai; he claimed his origin was Xie of Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Baoluo was a man of Dai; he claimed descent from Xie in Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 家世好賓客，尚氣俠，頻為北土所知。

translations.literal: His family for generations loved hosting guests, valued chivalry and bold spirit, and was frequently known among the northern lands.
translations.idiomatic: His family for generations loved guests, honored bold spirit, and was well known across the northern lands.

sentences.zh: 保洛少率健，善弓馬。

translations.literal: Baoluo from youth was forthright and robust, skilled in bow and horse.
translations.idiomatic: Baoluo from youth was forthright and robust, skilled with bow and horse.

sentences.zh: 魏孝昌中，北鎮擾亂，保洛亦隨衆南下。

translations.literal: In the Xiaochang era of Wei, when the northern garrisons were in turmoil, Baoluo also followed the masses south.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiaochang era of Wei, when the northern garrisons fell into turmoil, Baoluo followed the crowds south.

sentences.zh: 葛榮僭逆，以保洛為領左右。

translations.literal: Ge Rong usurped; he made Baoluo leader of the left and right guard.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Rong usurped power and made Baoluo leader of the left and right guard.

sentences.zh: 榮敗，仍為尒朱榮統軍，累遷揚烈將軍、奉車都尉。

translations.literal: When Rong was defeated, he still served Erzhu Rong as army commander and was repeatedly promoted to General Who Raises the Array and Chief Commandant Who Attends the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: When Rong was defeated, he still served Erzhu Rong as army commander and rose to general who raises the array and chief commandant who attends the chariot.

sentences.zh: 後隸高祖為都督，從討步蕃。

translations.literal: Later he came under the Grand Ancestor as commander, following to attack Bufan.
translations.idiomatic: Later he came under Gao Huan as commander and followed to attack Bufan.

sentences.zh: 及高祖起義，保洛為帳內，從破尒朱兆於廣阿。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor raised the revolt, Baoluo served in the personal guard, following to defeat Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan raised the revolt, Baoluo served in the personal guard and followed to defeat Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a.

sentences.zh: 尋遷右將軍、中散大夫，仍以帳內從高祖圍鄴城，既拔，除平南將軍、光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Right General and Palace Attendant Forbearing Counsel, still in the personal guard following the Grand Ancestor in besieging Ye; once it was taken, he was made General Who Pacifies the South and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to right general and palace attendant forbearing counsel, still in the personal guard following Gao Huan in besieging Ye; once the city fell, he was made general who pacifies the south and grand master of splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 從破尒朱兆等於韓陵，因隨高祖入洛，加安東將軍。

translations.literal: He followed in defeating Erzhu Zhao and others at Hanling, then followed the Grand Ancestor into Luoyang, additionally made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: He followed in defeating Erzhu Zhao and others at Hanling, then followed Gao Huan into Luoyang and was additionally made general who pacifies the east.

sentences.zh: 後高祖啟減國邑，分授將士，保洛隨例封昌平縣薄家城鄉男一百戶。

translations.literal: Later the Grand Ancestor proposed reducing state fiefs and distributing them to officers and soldiers; Baoluo by precedent was enfeoffed Baron of Bojia City Township, Changping County, with one hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Later Gao Huan proposed reducing state fiefs and distributing them among officers and soldiers; Baoluo by precedent was enfeoffed baron of Bojia City Township in Changping County with one hundred households.

sentences.zh: 魏出帝不協於高祖，令儀同賈顯智率豫州刺史斛斯壽東趣濟州。

translations.literal: Emperor Chu of Wei was at odds with the Grand Ancestor; he ordered Senior Grand Master of Equal Rank Jia Xianzhi to lead Yu Province Governor Husishou east toward Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Chu of Wei was at odds with Gao Huan; he ordered senior grand master of equal rank Jia Xianzhi to lead Yu Province governor Husishou east toward Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 高祖遣大都督竇泰濟自滑臺拒顯智，保洛隸泰前驅。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor dispatched Grand Commander Dou Tai to cross the river from Huatai to resist Xianzhi; Baoluo served under Tai as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan dispatched Grand Commander Dou Tai to cross from Huatai and resist Xianzhi; Baoluo served under Tai as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 事定，轉都督。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, he was transferred to commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, he was transferred to commander.

sentences.zh: 從高祖襲夏州，剋之。

translations.literal: He followed the Grand Ancestor in raiding Xia Province and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Gao Huan in raiding Xia Province and took it.

sentences.zh: 万俟受洛干之降也，高祖遣保洛與諸將於路接援。

translations.literal: When Wan Qishouluogan surrendered, the Grand Ancestor dispatched Baoluo with various generals to receive and support him on the road.
translations.idiomatic: When Wan Qishouluogan surrendered, Gao Huan dispatched Baoluo with the other generals to receive and support him on the road.

sentences.zh: 元象初，除西夏州刺史、當州大都督，又以前後功，封安武縣伯，邑四百戶。

translations.literal: At the start of Yuanxiang he was appointed Governor of Western Xia Province and Great Commander for the province; for his cumulative merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Anwu County with a fief of four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Yuanxiang he was made governor of Western Xia Province and great commander for the province; for merit accumulated over many campaigns he was enfeoffed baron of Anwu County with a fief of four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 轉行蔚州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to act as Governor of You Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as acting governor of You Province.

sentences.zh: 從高祖攻周文帝於邙山，圍玉壁，攻龍門。

translations.literal: He followed the Grand Ancestor in attacking the Zhou Emperor Wen at Mang Mountain, besieging Yubi and assaulting Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Gao Huan in attacking Yuwen Tai at Mang Mountain, besieging Yubi and storming Longmen.

sentences.zh: 還，留鎮晉州。

translations.literal: On their return he was left to garrison Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march he was left to garrison Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 顯祖受禪，仍為刺史，所在聚斂為務，民吏怨之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wenxuan received the abdication he remained governor; wherever he served, exaction was his chief concern, and officials and commoners resented him.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Yang received the mandate, Zhang Baoluo remained governor — and wherever he held office, exaction was his chief business. Officials and commoners alike resented him.

sentences.zh: 濟南初，出為滄州刺史，封敷城郡王。

translations.literal: At the start of the Jinan reign he was sent out as Governor of Cang Province and enfeoffed Prince of Fucheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Jinan reign he was sent out as governor of Cang Province and enfeoffed prince of Fucheng Commandery.

sentences.zh: 為在州聚斂，免官，削奪王爵。

translations.literal: For exactions while in the province he was dismissed from office and stripped of his princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: For squeezing the province dry he was dismissed from office and stripped of his princely rank.

sentences.zh: 及卒，贈以前官，追復本封。

translations.literal: At his death he was posthumously granted his former office and his original enfeoffment was restored.
translations.idiomatic: At his death he was posthumously granted his former office, and his original enfeoffment was restored.

sentences.zh: 子默言嗣。

translations.literal: His son Moyan succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Moyan succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 武平末，衛將軍。

translations.literal: At the end of Wuping he was Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Wuping he held the post of guard general.

sentences.zh: 以帳內從高祖出山東，又有曲珍、段琛、牒舍樂、尉摽、乞伏貴和及弟令和、王康德，並以軍功至大官。

translations.literal: Those who as tent guards followed the Grand Ancestor east into Shandong included Qu Zhen, Duan Chen, Die Shele, Wei Biao, Qifu Guihe and his brother Linghe, and Wang Kede — all of whom rose to high office through military merit.
translations.idiomatic: Others who as tent guards followed Gao Huan east into Shandong included Qu Zhen, Duan Chen, Die Shele, Wei Biao, Qifu Guihe and his brother Linghe, and Wang Kede — all of whom rose to high office on military merit alone.

sentences.zh: 曲珍字舍洛，西平酒泉人也。

translations.literal: Qu Zhen, styled Sheluo, was a native of Jiuquan in Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: Qu Zhen, styled Sheluo, was a native of Jiuquan in Xiping.

sentences.zh: 壯勇善騎射。

translations.literal: Bold and brave, he was skilled in riding and archery.
translations.idiomatic: Bold and brave, he was skilled in riding and archery.

sentences.zh: 以帳內從高祖晉州，仍起義，所在征討。

translations.literal: As a tent guard he followed the Grand Ancestor at Jin Province, then joined the uprising and campaigned wherever sent.
translations.idiomatic: As a tent guard he followed Gao Huan at Jin Province, then joined the uprising and fought wherever the army was sent.

sentences.zh: 武定末，封富平縣伯。

translations.literal: At the end of Wuding he was enfeoffed Baron of Fuping County.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Wuding he was enfeoffed baron of Fuping County.

sentences.zh: 天保初，食黎陽郡幹，除晉州刺史。

translations.literal: At the start of Tianbao he drew income from Liyang Commandery and was appointed Governor of Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Tianbao he drew income from Liyang Commandery and was appointed governor of Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 武平初，遷豫州道行臺、尚書令、豫州刺史，卒，贈太尉。

translations.literal: At the start of Wuping he was transferred to Circuit Executive of Yuzhou, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yuzhou; at death he was posthumously granted Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Wuping he was transferred to circuit executive of Yuzhou, director of the Masters of Writing, and governor of Yuzhou; at his death he was posthumously granted grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 段琛字懷寶，代人也。

translations.literal: Duan Chen, styled Huaibao, was a native of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Chen, styled Huaibao, was a native of Dai.

sentences.zh: 少有武用。

translations.literal: From youth he had martial capacity.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he had real martial capacity.

sentences.zh: 從高祖起義信都。

translations.literal: He followed the Grand Ancestor in raising righteousness at Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Gao Huan in raising righteousness at Xindu.

sentences.zh: 天保中，光州刺史。

translations.literal: In the Tianbao era he was Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianbao era he served as governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 牒舍樂，武成開府儀同三司、營州刺史，封漢中郡公。

translations.literal: Die Shele held opening-establishment honor equal to the three excellencies as Governor of Ying Province under Emperor Wucheng, and was enfeoffed Duke of Hanzhong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Die Shele, under Emperor Wucheng, held opening-establishment honor equal to the three excellencies as governor of Ying Province and was enfeoffed duke of Hanzhong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 戰歿關中。

translations.literal: He died in battle in Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: He fell in battle in Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 尉摽，代人也。

translations.literal: Wei Biao was a native of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Biao was a native of Dai.

sentences.zh: 大寧初，封海昌王。

translations.literal: At the start of Daning he was enfeoffed Prince of Haichang.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Daning he was enfeoffed prince of Haichang.

sentences.zh: 子相貴嗣。

translations.literal: His son Xianggui succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xianggui succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 相貴，武平末晉州道行臺尚書僕射、晉州刺史。

translations.literal: Xianggui, at the end of Wuping, was Vice Director of the Masters of Writing on the Jin Province Circuit Executive and Governor of Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: Xianggui, at the end of Wuping, was vice director of the Masters of Writing on the Jin Province circuit executive and governor of Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 為行臺左丞侯子欽等密啟周武請帥，欽等為內應。

translations.literal: Circuit Executive Left Assistant Hou Ziqin and others secretly reported to Emperor Wu of Zhou requesting troops; Ziqin and the rest served as inside agents.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit executive left assistant Hou Ziqin and others secretly reported to Emperor Wu of Zhou, asking that troops be sent; Ziqin and his fellows were to serve as inside agents.

sentences.zh: 周武自率衆至城下，欽等夜開城門引軍入，鎖相貴送長安。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Zhou personally led his host to the city walls; at night Ziqin and the others opened the gates and brought the army in, bound Xianggui, and sent him to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Zhou personally led his host to the walls. That night Ziqin and the others opened the gates and admitted the army, bound Xianggui, and sent him to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: He soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died.

sentences.zh: 弟相願，強幹有膽略。

translations.literal: His younger brother Xiangyuan was forceful and possessed courage and stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Xiangyuan was forceful, with courage and stratagem to match.

sentences.zh: 武平末，領軍大將軍。

translations.literal: At the end of Wuping he was Army-leading Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Wuping he was army-leading grand general.

sentences.zh: 自平陽至幷州，及到鄴，每立計將殺高阿那肱，廢後主，立廣寧王，事竟不果。

translations.literal: From Pingyang to Bingzhou, and again when he reached Ye, he repeatedly plotted to kill Gao Anagong, depose the Later Sovereign, and set up the Prince of Guangning — but in the end the plan came to nothing.
translations.idiomatic: From Pingyang to Bingzhou, and again on reaching Ye, he repeatedly plotted to kill Gao Anagong, depose the Later Sovereign, and set up the Prince of Guangning — yet in the end the plan came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 及廣寧被出，相願拔佩刀斫柱而嘆曰：「大事去矣，知復何言！」

translations.literal: When the Prince of Guangning was sent away, Xiangyuan drew his belt-knife, struck a pillar, and sighed: "The great cause is lost — what more is there to say!"
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Guangning was sent away, Xiangyuan drew his belt-knife, struck a pillar, and sighed: "The great cause is lost — what more is there to say!"

sentences.zh: 貴和及令和兄弟，武平末，並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: The brothers Qifu Guihe and Linghe, at the end of Wuping, both held opening-establishment honor equal to the three excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: The brothers Qifu Guihe and Linghe, at the end of Wuping, both held opening-establishment honor equal to the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 令和，領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Linghe was General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: Linghe was general who leads the army.

sentences.zh: 幷州未敗前，與領軍大將軍韓建業、武衛大將軍封輔相相繼投周軍。

translations.literal: Before Bingzhou fell, he, together with Army-leading Grand General Han Jianye and Martial Guard Grand General Feng Fuxiang, successively defected to the Zhou army.
translations.idiomatic: Before Bingzhou fell, he, together with army-leading grand general Han Jianye and martial guard grand general Feng Fuxiang, defected one after another to the Zhou army.

sentences.zh: 令和授柱國，封西河郡公。

translations.literal: Linghe was granted Pillar of State and enfeoffed Duke of Xihe Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Linghe was granted pillar of state and enfeoffed duke of Xihe Commandery.

sentences.zh: 隋大業初，卒於秦州總管。

translations.literal: At the start of Daye under Sui he died while serving as commander-in-chief at Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Daye under Sui he died while serving as commander-in-chief at Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 建業、輔相，俱不知所從來。

translations.literal: Jianye and Fuxiang — neither is known for certain whence they came.
translations.idiomatic: Jianye and Fuxiang — of neither is it known for certain whence they came.

sentences.zh: 建業授上柱國，封郇國公，隋開皇中卒。

translations.literal: Jianye was granted Supreme Pillar of State and enfeoffed Duke of the State of Xun; he died in the Kaihuang era of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: Jianye was granted supreme pillar of state and enfeoffed duke of the state of Xun; he died in the Kaihuang era of Sui.

sentences.zh: 輔相，上柱國，封郡公。

translations.literal: Fuxiang was Supreme Pillar of State and enfeoffed a commandery duke.
translations.idiomatic: Fuxiang was supreme pillar of state and enfeoffed a commandery duke.

sentences.zh: 周武平幷州，即以為朔州總管。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu of Zhou pacified Bingzhou, he was immediately made commander-in-chief at Shuo Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Zhou pacified Bingzhou, he was immediately made commander-in-chief at Shuo Province.

sentences.zh: 康德，代人也。

translations.literal: Wang Kede was a native of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kede was a native of Dai.

sentences.zh: 歷數州刺史、並省尚書，封新蔡郡王。

translations.literal: He successively served as governor of several provinces and as an official of the Masters of Writing in the Bing provincial secretariat, and was enfeoffed Prince of Xincai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as governor of several provinces and as an official in the Bing provincial Masters of Writing, and was enfeoffed prince of Xincai Commandery.

sentences.zh: 侯莫陳相，代人也。

translations.literal: Houmo Chenxiang was a native of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Houmo Chenxiang was a native of Dai.

sentences.zh: 祖伏頹，魏第一領民酋長。

translations.literal: His grandfather Fuyui was First Chieftain of Registered Tribal Peoples under Wei.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Fuyui was first chieftain of registered tribal peoples under Wei.

sentences.zh: 父斛古提，朔州刺史、白水郡公。

translations.literal: His father Huguti was Governor of Shuo Province and Duke of Baishui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Huguti was governor of Shuo Province and duke of Baishui Commandery.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：高祖世居雲代，以英雄見知。

translations.literal: The historian writes: The Grand Ancestor for generations dwelt in Yun and Dai, known for heroic stature.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: Gao Huan for generations dwelt in Yun and Dai, known to all for heroic stature.

sentences.zh: 後過尒朱，武功漸振，鄉邑故人，彌相推重。

translations.literal: Later he passed through the Erzhu clan and his martial renown gradually rose; old friends of town and district ever more deferred to him.
translations.idiomatic: Later he passed through the Erzhu clan, and his martial renown gradually rose — old friends of town and district ever more deferred to him.

sentences.zh: 賀拔允以昆季乖離，處猜嫌之地，初以舊望矜護，而竟不獲令終，比於吳、蜀之安瑾、亮，方知器識之淺深也。

translations.literal: He Bayun, separated from his brothers and dwelling in a place of suspicion and distrust, was at first sheltered for old standing — yet in the end did not obtain a good death; compared with Wu's Zhuge Jin and Shu's Zhuge Liang, one knows how shallow or deep a man's capacity and discernment may be.
translations.idiomatic: He Bayun, torn from his brothers and dwelling in a place of suspicion, was at first sheltered for old standing — yet in the end did not obtain a good death. Set beside Wu's Zhuge Jin and Shu's Zhuge Liang, one sees how shallow or deep a man's capacity and discernment may run.

sentences.zh: 劉貴、蔡儁有先見之明，霸業始基，義深匡贊，配饗清廟，豈徒然哉。

translations.literal: Liu Gui and Cai Jun had foresight; when the hegemonic enterprise was first laid they loyally supported it from deep conviction — to share sacrifice in the Pure Temple was no empty honor.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gui and Cai Jun had foresight. When the hegemonic enterprise was first laid, they loyally supported it from deep conviction — to share sacrifice in the Pure Temple was no empty honor.

sentences.zh: 韓賢等及聞義舉，競趣戎行，憑附末光，申其志力，化為公侯，固其宜矣。

translations.literal: When Han Xian and the rest heard the righteous uprising, they raced to the ranks of war, leaned on reflected glory, and gave their will and strength full play — that they became lords and marquises was only fitting.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Xian and the rest heard the righteous uprising, they raced to the ranks of war, leaned on reflected glory, and gave their will and strength full play — that they rose to become lords and marquises was only fitting.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：帝鄉之親，世有其人。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Among kin of the imperial homeland, each generation has had such men.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: Among kin of the imperial homeland, each generation has had such men.

sentences.zh: 降靈雲朔，載挺良臣。

translations.literal: Spirit descended on the Yun-Shuo lands; loyal ministers rose in their season.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit descended on the Yun-Shuo lands; loyal ministers rose in their season.

sentences.zh: 功名之地，望古為鄰。

translations.literal: In the land where merit and fame are won, they stand as neighbors to the ancients.
translations.idiomatic: In the land where merit and fame are won, they stand as neighbors to the ancients.

sentences.zh: 全文以中華書局、一九七二年十一月、第一版《北齊書》為本校。

translations.literal: The entire text has been collated against the November 1972 first edition of the Book of Northern Qi published by Zhonghua Shuju.
translations.idiomatic: The entire text has been collated against the November 1972 first edition of the Book of Northern Qi published by Zhonghua Shuju.
